title: Palestinian couples tie the knot in mass wedding in Gaza
english: A total of 250 couples in Gaza participated in a mass wedding ceremony to celebrate their commitment to one another. The event was supported by a humanitarian initiative backed by the UAE called Operation Chivalrous Knight. This celebration offered a moment of joy and hope for the participants amidst the ongoing conflict in the region.
amharic: በጋዛ የሚገኙ 250 ጥንዶች በአንድ ላይ በተዘጋጀ የጋራ የሰርግ ስነ-ስርዓት ላይ በመሳተፍ ትዳራቸውን መስርተዋል። ይህ ዝግጅት የተባበሩት አረብ ኤምሬቶች በሚደግፈው 'ኦፕሬሽን ቺቫለረስ ናይት' በተሰኘ የሰብአዊ ድጋፍ ዘመቻ አስተባባሪነት የተከናወነ ነው። በክልሉ እየተካሄደ ባለው ጦርነት መካከል ይህ የጋራ ሠርግ ለጥንዶቹ የደስታ እና የተስፋ ጊዜን ፈጥሯል።
oromo: Gaza keessatti qophii cidha waloo ta'een gaa'elli kan hiyyooman qaxalee 250 ta'u. Sirni cidhaa kun dhaabbata UAE deggaru 'Operation Chivalrous Knight' jedhamuun kan qophaa'e dha. Wallalloo fi waraana naannichaa keessatti, cidha waloo kana godhuun isaanii qaxalee kanneeniif abdii fi gammachuu ta'ee jira.

title: Who is Stephen Miller, Trump’s new White House chief of staff?
english: President Donald Trump has appointed his long-time advisor and immigration policy strategist, Stephen Miller, as the new White House chief of staff. Miller, known for his firm conservative views and vocal support of mass deportation efforts, will replace Susie Wiles in this influential role. His appointment comes at a challenging time, as Democrats prepare to take control of Congress and potentially investigate his past political actions.
amharic: ፕሬዝዳንት ዶናልድ ትራምፕ የረጅም ጊዜ አማካሪያቸውን እና የስደተኞች ፖሊሲ ቀያሽ የሆኑትን ስቲቨን ሚለርን አዲሱ የኋይት ሃውስ ኃላፊ አድርገው ሾመዋል። በጠንካራ ወግ አጥባቂ አቋማቸው እና በጅምላ ስደተኞችን የማባረር እቅድ ደጋፊ በመሆን የሚታወቁት ሚለር፣ ይህንን ስልጣን ከሱዚ ዋይልስ ይረከባሉ። ይህ ሹመት የተከናወነው ዲሞክራቶች የኮንግረስን መቆጣጠሪያ በመረከብ በባለስልጣኑ ያለፈ ተግባር ላይ ምርመራ ለማድረግ ዝግጅት እያደረጉ ባለበት አስቸጋሪ ወቅት ነው።
oromo: Pireezidanti Doonaald Tiraamp gorsaa isaanii kan turan fi qajeelfama baqattoota irratti beekamtii qaban Stiiivan Miilar, itti gaafatamaa waajjira mana mootummaa (White House) haaraa godhatanii muudaniiru. Miilar ilaalcha isaanii kan mirgaa fi sagantaa baqattoota biyyattii keessaa baasuuf qaban irratti kan beekaman yoo ta'u, iddoo Suuzii Waayiles bu'uun hojii kana gahu. Muudamni kun kan raawwatame yeroo paartiin Diimokraatawaa mana maree biyyattii to'achuun isaan irratti qorannoo geggeessuuf qophaa'aa jiranitti.

title: Protesters break into Microsoft data centre site in Amsterdam
english: Hundreds of protesters in Amsterdam occupied a Microsoft data centre construction site to demonstrate against the rapid expansion of AI infrastructure. Activists argue that these facilities consume excessive amounts of energy and water, and they have voiced concerns about the societal impact of AI technologies. Police eventually removed the demonstrators and arrested nearly 200 individuals during the incident, which is part of a larger series of protests occurring across 15 European countries.
amharic: በአምስተርዳም በመቶዎች የሚቆጠሩ ተቃዋሚዎች የሰው ሰራሽ አስተውሎት (AI) መሠረተ ልማቶችን መስፋፋት በመቃወም በማይክሮሶፍት የዳታ ማዕከል ግንባታ ቦታ ላይ ወረራ ፈፅመዋል። ተቃዋሚዎቹ እነዚህ ማዕከላት ከፍተኛ መጠን ያለው የኤሌክትሪክ ኃይል እና ውኃ እንደሚፈጁ በመግለጽ፣ የቴክኖሎጂው ተፅዕኖ አሳሳቢ መሆኑን ተናግረዋል። ፖሊስ ተቃዋሚዎችን ከግንባታው ቦታ በማስወጣት ወደ 200 የሚጠጉ ሰዎችን በቁጥጥር ስር አውሏል፤ ይህ ተቃውሞ በአውሮፓ በ15 አገራት እየተካሄደ ካለው የተቀናጀ እንቅስቃሴ አካል ነው።
oromo: Amsteerdamitti namoonni dhibbaan lakkaa'aman, babal'ina bu'uuraalee misoomaa 'AI' mormuun iddoo ijaarsa daataa sentara Maaykiroosoftii cabsuun seene. Hiriirtotni kun daataa sentaroonni kunneen humna ibsaa fi bishaan hedduu akka fixan, akkasumas miidhaa teeknoolojiin kun qabu ilaalchisee yaaddoo qaban ibsataniiru. Poolisiin hiriirtota kana iddoo ijaarsichaa irraa kan baase yoo ta'u, namoota 200 gadi ta'an to'annoo jala oolcheera; hiriirri kunis biyyoota Awurooppaa 15 keessatti sochiilee godhamaa jiran keessaa tokko.

title: Trump promotes Stephen Miller to Chief of Staff ‘to run things well’
english: President Donald Trump has appointed his long-term advisor Stephen Miller as the new White House Chief of Staff. Miller, known for shaping Trump's strict domestic policies, is taking over the role from Susie Wiles. This administrative change follows the Republican Party's loss of control in Congress during the recent midterm elections.
amharic: ፕሬዝዳንት ዶናልድ ትራምፕ የረጅም ጊዜ አማካሪያቸውን ስቲቨን ሚለርን የኋይት ሀውስ የሰራተኞች አለቃ አድርገው ሾሙ። በትራምፕ ጥብቅ የሀገር ውስጥ ፖሊሲዎች ቀያሽ በመባል የሚታወቁት ሚለር፣ ይህንን ኃላፊነት ከሱዚ ዋይልስ ተረክበዋል። ይህ የሹመት ለውጥ የመጣው ሪፐብሊካኖች በመካከለኛው ምርጫ የኮንግረስ ቁጥጥርን ካጡ በኋላ ነው።
oromo: Pirezidaanti Dooktar Doonaald Tiraamp gorsaa isaanii kan yeroo dheeraa Stiiven Miiler itti gaafatamaa hojjettoota mana mootummaa (Chief of Staff) godhatanii muudaniiru. Miiler imaammata keessoo Tiraamp kan jabaa ta'an bocuudhaan kan beekaman yoo ta'u, itti gaafatamummaa kana Suuzii Waayiles irraa kan fudhatanidha. jijjiiramni kun kan dhufe paartiin Riippabilikaa filannoo giddu galeessaatti to'annoo Koongirasii erga dhabee boodadha.

title: AI stocks climb after trillions wiped from market values
english: Technology and AI-related stocks are seeing a partial recovery after suffering significant losses that wiped trillions from their market value. This rebound was fueled by positive US employment data, helping to stabilize major indexes like the Nasdaq after a period of intense selling. While US markets have started to regain momentum, international stock exchanges in Asia and Europe remained under pressure due to ongoing economic concerns.
amharic: በቴክኖሎጂ እና በሰው ሰራሽ አስተውሎት (AI) ዘርፍ የተሰማሩ ኩባንያዎች አክሲዮኖች ከፍተኛ የገበያ ዋጋ ካጡ በኋላ በከፊል ማገገም ችለዋል። ይህ መሻሻል በአሜሪካ የተመዘገበው ጠንካራ የስራ ዕድል መረጃ ለገበያው መረጋጋት አስተዋጽኦ በማድረጉ ነው። በአሜሪካ ገበያዎች ላይ መሻሻል ቢታይም፣ በአውሮፓ እና እስያ የሚገኙ የአክሲዮን ገበያዎች አሁንም በኢኮኖሚያዊ ስጋቶች ምክንያት መውረዳቸውን ቀጥለዋል።
oromo: Hojiiwwan teeknooloojii fi AI irratti bobba'an qabeenya gurguddaa erga dhabanii booda deebi'anii sadarkaa gaariirra gahaa jiru. Furmaanni kun kan dhufuuf sababa ragaa hojii Ameerikaa keessatti argamee fi gabaan akkasumas qabeenyi gurguddaan akka tasgabbaa'an waan godheefidha. Gabaan Ameerikaa yoo ol ka'u, gabaaleen gurguddaan Awurooppaa fi Eeshiyaa garuu har'as rakkoo dinagdee irraa kan ka'e gadi bu'aa jiru.

title: Four midterms takeaways for 2028 White House race
english: Following the US midterm elections, political focus is shifting toward the 2028 presidential race. Democrats gained significant momentum after winning control of Congress, while several governors and senators from both parties have bolstered their national profiles through their performance in these midterms. Although the election outcomes provide a glimpse into potential candidates, history shows that midterm results do not always predict who will ultimately secure the presidency.
amharic: የአሜሪካ የመካከለኛ ዘመን ምርጫ መጠናቀቁን ተከትሎ፣ የፖለቲካ ትኩረት ወደ 2028 የፕሬዚዳንታዊ ምርጫ እየዞረ ይገኛል። ዲሞክራቶች በኮንግረስ ያገኙት ድል ትልቅ መነቃቃትን የፈጠረ ሲሆን፣ በምርጫው ጠንካራ ብቃት ያሳዩ አንዳንድ የክልል ገዥዎች እና ሴናተሮችም ለቀጣዩ ውድድር ስማቸው በግንባር ቀደምትነት እየተነሳ ነው። ምንም እንኳን የምርጫ ውጤቶች የወደፊት እጩዎችን ለመለየት ቢረዱም፣ የመካከለኛ ዘመን ውጤቶች የፕሬዚዳንታዊ ምርጫውን ውጤት ሁልጊዜ እንደማያረጋግጡ ታሪክ ያሳያል።
oromo: Bu'aan filannoo giddu galeessa Ameerikaa booda, xiyyeeffannoon siyaasaa gara filannoo pireezidaantummaa bara 2028tti jijjiiramaa jira. Diimokraatonni kongiresii to'achuu isaaniitiin injifannoo argatan yoo ta'u, gama biraatiin ammoo qondaaltoonni mootummaa tokko tokko bu'aa filannoo kana keessatti argataniin beekamtii argachuu danda'aniiru. Bu'aan filannoo kanaa dorgomtoota gara fuulduraa agarsiisuu danda'us, seenaan akka hubachiisutti bu'aan filannoo giddu galeessaa yeroo hunda eenyu akka injifatu dursanii himuuf ga'aa miti.

title: New wave of bomb threats hit European airlines
english: European airlines are facing a major disruption following a third wave of bomb threats this week, resulting in diverted flights and military jet escorts. Concurrently, several prominent media outlets across Europe, including those in Ireland, were evacuated due to similar security warnings. While no explosives have been discovered and the incidents are currently treated as hoaxes, officials are investigating whether these widespread threats are part of a coordinated effort to cause public alarm.
amharic: የአውሮፓ አየር መንገድ ኩባንያዎች በዚህ ሳምንት ለሶስተኛ ጊዜ በተከሰተ የቦምብ ማስፈራሪያ ወረራ ከፍተኛ መስተጓጎል ገጥሟቸዋል። በዚህ ምክንያት በርካታ በረራዎች ተቀይረዋል እንዲሁም የጦር ጄቶች እንዲሸኙ ተደርጓል። በተመሳሳይ መልኩ በአየርላንድ እና በሌሎች የአውሮፓ ሀገራት የሚገኙ ዋና ዋና የመገናኛ ብዙኃን ድርጅቶች ተመሳሳይ ማስፈራሪያ ደርሶባቸው ሰራተኞቻቸውን ለቀዋል፤ እስካሁን ምንም አይነት ፈንጂ ባይገኝም ባለስልጣናት ይህ ድርጊት ህዝብን ለማሸበር የተደራጀ ሴራ ይሁን አይሁን በማጣራት ላይ ናቸው።
oromo: ጂኦግራፊያዊ አውሮፓ ውስጥ የሚገኙ አየር መንገዶች በዚህ ሳምንት ለሶስተኛ ጊዜ በተደጋጋሚ በደረሰባቸው የቦምብ ማስፈራሪያ ምክንያት ከፍተኛ መስተጓጎል አጋጥሟቸዋል። ይህ ሁኔታ በረራዎችን እንዲቀይሩ እና የጦር ጄቶች እንዲያጅቡ ያደረገ ሲሆን፣ በአየርላንድ እና በሌሎች የአውሮፓ ሀገራት የሚገኙ ታዋቂ የሚዲያ ተቋማትም ተመሳሳይ ማስፈራሪያ ደርሶባቸው እንዲለቀቁ ተደርገዋል። ምንም እንኳን እስካሁን ፈንጂ ባይገኝም እና ማስፈራሪያዎቹ የውሸት ወሬ እንደሆኑ ቢታመንም፣ ባለስልጣናት ይህ ህዝብን ለማሸበር የታቀደ የተቀናጀ ጥረት ይሁን አይሁን እየመረመሩ ይገኛል።

title: Kenyan doomsday cult leader given life sentence for murdering 191 people
english: A Kenyan court has sentenced cult leader Paul Mackenzie to 200 years in prison for the deaths of 191 people, mostly children. Mackenzie coerced his followers into starving themselves and their families under the belief that it would lead them to meet Jesus. Along with 28 accomplices who helped enforce these deadly fasting orders, he was held responsible for one of the most tragic cult-related mass killings in history.
amharic: የኬንያ ፍርድ ቤት የኑፋቄ መሪ የሆኑትን ፖል ማኬንዚን በአብዛኛው ህጻናት የሆኑ 191 ሰዎችን በመግደል ወንጀል የ200 ዓመት እስራት ፈርዶባቸዋል። ማኬንዚ ተከታዮቹ ከኢየሱስ ጋር እንገናኛለን በሚል እምነት እራሳቸውን እና ልጆቻቸውን በረሃብ እንዲያቀጡ አድርጓቸዋል። ይህ አስከፊ ድርጊት እንዲፈጸም ድጋፍ ያደረጉ ሌሎች 28 ተባባሪዎቹም የተለያዩ የቅጣት ውሳኔዎች የተላለፈባቸው ሲሆን፣ ጉዳዩ በዓለም አቀፍ ደረጃ ከፍተኛ ድንጋጤን ፈጥሯል።
oromo: Mana murtii Keeniyaatti hogganaan garee amantii sobaa Pool Maakenzii namoota 191, kanneen keessaa hedduun isaanii daa'imman ta'an ajjeesuun himatamee waggaa 200 hidhamuun murteeffameef. Maakenzii hordoftoonni isaa gara samiitti deemanii Yesusiin arguuf jecha akka of beela'anifi ijoollee isaanii beelaan ajjeesan dirqisiiseera. Namoonni 28 ta'an kanneen yakka kana keessatti gargaarsa taasisanis adabbii garagaraa kan itti murtaa'e yoo ta'u, badiin kun adunyaa maratti kan nama naasise dha.

title: US city votes to divest from Israel
english: A significant majority of voters in Providence, Rhode Island, have approved a measure to stop the city from investing in entities linked to the Israeli-Palestinian conflict. This decision reflects a growing movement within the United States that advocates for divestment from Israel over human rights concerns. The vote highlights a shift toward more critical public sentiment regarding current US policies toward the Middle East.
amharic: በፕሮቪደንስ፣ ሮድ አይላንድ የሚኖሩ አብዛኛዎቹ መራጮች ከተማዋ ከእስራኤል ጋር በተያያዙ ግጭቶች ውስጥ ከሚሳተፉ ተቋማት ላይ ኢንቨስትመንቷን እንድታቆም የሚጠይቅ ሕግ አጽድቀዋል። ይህ ውሳኔ በዩናይትድ ስቴትስ ውስጥ በእስራኤል የሰብአዊ መብት አያያዝ ላይ በመንተራስ ከኢንቨስትመንት የመውጣት እንቅስቃሴ እየጨመረ መምጣቱን ያሳያል። ድምጽ አሰጣጡ በአሜሪካ የውጭ ፖሊሲ ላይ ያለው የህዝብ አስተያየት እየተቀየረ መምጣቱን የሚያሳይ ነው።
oromo: Magaalaa Providence, Rhode Island keessatti sagalee caalmaa guddaadhaan, jiraattonni magaalli sun walitti buiinsa Israa'el fi Palasxiin wajjin walqabatee bu'uuraalee dinagdee irratti qabdu akka dhaabdu murteessaniiru. Murteen kun biyya Ameerikaa keessatti dhimma mirga namoomaa fi Israa'el irratti hundaa'uun maallaqa ofii baasuu fi invastmentii addaan kutuuf sochii bal'aa jiru agarsiisa. Sagalee kennamuun kun ilaalchi ummataa ilaalcha siyaasa Ameerikaa gara Baha Giddu galeessaatti qabdu irratti jijjiiramaa jiraachuu mirkaneessa.

title: US prosecutor who led Trump-backed election probe exits Justice Department
english: Jason Reding Quinones, a U.S. Attorney linked to the Trump administration, has resigned from his position at the Department of Justice following the recent Democratic midterm election wins. During his tenure, Quinones directed a controversial investigation into the 2016 election and pursued legal actions against international figures like Raul Castro. His departure follows a series of staff changes as the administration prepares for upcoming investigations from the incoming party.
amharic: ከዶናልድ ትራምፕ አስተዳደር ጋር ግንኙነት የነበራቸው የአሜሪካ የፍትህ ሚኒስቴር አቃቤ ህግ ጄሰን ሬዲንግ ኩዊኖነስ ከስልጣናቸው ለቀዋል። ኩዊኖነስ እ.ኤ.አ በ2016 ምርጫ ላይ የተደረገ ምርመራን በመምራት እና እንደ ራውል ካስትሮ ባሉ ዓለም አቀፍ ግለሰቦች ላይ ክስ በመመስረት ይታወቃሉ። በዴሞክራቶች የምርጫ ድል ተከትሎ እየተደረገ ካለው የአስተዳደር ለውጥ እና ሊመጣ ከሚችለው ምርመራ ጋር በተያያዘ ይህ መልቀቅ ተከናውኗል።
oromo: Abbaan alangaa mootummaa US, Jason Reding Quinones, mootummaa Trump waliin hariiroo cimaa qabaachuun beekamu, bu'aa filannoo giddu-galeessaa kanaan dura injifannoo Dimookraatonni argataniin wal-qabatee hojii isaa gadhiiseera. Quinones qorannoo filannoo bara 2016 fi himannaa namoota akka Raul Castro irratti dhihaate hoogganaa ture. Gadi-lakkisuun isaa kun jijjiirama bulchiinsa mootummaa fi qorannoo gama mormitootaatiin dhufuuf karoorfame keessatti kan raawwatame dha.

title: Paraguay resumes Pena impeachment proceedings as financial crisis deepens
english: Paraguay's Senate has moved forward with impeachment proceedings against President Santiago Pena following a massive financial collapse involving Ueno Bank. The crisis, which has left over half the population unable to access their funds, has triggered accusations of conflicts of interest linked to the President’s past business connections. Despite offering an apology and tendering a resignation, Pena is now facing formal removal efforts as authorities launch criminal investigations into the banking scandal.
amharic: የፓራጓይ ሴኔት በዩኤኖ ባንክ ውድቀት ምክንያት በፕሬዚዳንት ሳንቲያጎ ፔና ላይ የክስ ሂደቱን ቀጥሏል። ከግማሽ በላይ የሚሆነው የሀገሪቱ ህዝብ የባንክ አካውንቱን ማግኘት ባለመቻሉ ከፍተኛ ቀውስ የተፈጠረ ሲሆን፣ በፕሬዚዳንቱ ያለፈ የንግድ ግንኙነት ላይ የጥቅም ግጭት ክስ ቀርቦባቸዋል። ፔና ይቅርታ ጠይቀው ስልጣን መልቀቃቸውን ቢገልጹም፣ በባንክ ቅሌቱ ላይ ምርመራዎች እየተካሄዱ ባለበት በዚህ ወቅት የሀገሪቱ ህግ አውጪዎች ከስልጣን ለማውረድ እየሰሩ ነው።
oromo: Mana maree biyyattii Paaraaguwaay keessatti, kufuatii baankii 'Ueno' waliin walqabatee Preezidaant Saantiyaagoo Peenaarratti tarkaanfiin himannaa mootummaa irraa buusuu itti fufeera. Uummanni biyyattii walakkaa ol ta'u maallaqa isaa argachuu waan dadhabeef, mootummaan kun rakkoo dinagdee hamaa keessa seeneera. Preezidaant Peenaan dhimma kana irratti dhiifama gaafatanii aangoo gadhiisuu isaanii ibsatanis, seera baastoonni himannaa isaan irratti dhihaate hordofuun aangoo irraa buusuuf socho'aa jiru.

title: Taiwan to close representative office in Papua New Guinea, blames China
english: Taiwan is shutting down its representative office in Papua New Guinea and ending all technical and medical cooperation programs. The decision follows intense pressure from China, which prompted the host nation to demand the office's closure. Additionally, Taiwan will stop all imports of liquefied natural gas from Papua New Guinea as a direct response to this diplomatic fallout.
amharic: ታይዋን በፓፑዋ ኒው ጊኒ የሚገኘውን የወኪል ቢሮዋን እንደምትዘጋ እና የቴክኒክና የህክምና ትብብር መርሃ ግብሮቿን እንደምታቆም አስታውቃለች። ይህ ውሳኔ የተወሰነው ቻይና ባሳደረችው ከፍተኛ ጫና ምክንያት የአስተናጋጁ ሀገር ቢሮውን እንዲዘጋ በመጠየቋ ነው። ከዚህ ጋር በተያያዘ ታይዋን ከፓፑዋ ኒው ጊኒ የምታደርገውን የፈሳሽ የተፈጥሮ ጋዝ ግዢ ሙሉ በሙሉ ለማቆም ወስናለች።
oromo: Taiwan waajjira bakka bu'ummaa ishee kan Papua New Guinea keessatti argamu cufuufi gargaarsa tekinikaa fi fayyaa hunduu akka dhaabbatu murteessiteetti. Murtii kana kan fidde dhiibbaa cimaa Chaayinaan geessiste ta'uun, biyyi sun waajjiricha akka cufu dirqisiisuu isheeti. Kana malees, Taiwan tarkaanfii kanaaf deebii kennuuf jecha, gaazii uumamaa Papua New Guinea irraa bitachuu guutummaatti dhaabuuf murteessiteetti.

title: Jerusalem Daily: Arab parties back Eisenkot against Netanyahu
english: Arab political parties in Israel, including the Joint List and Ra’am, are supporting Gadi Eisenkot's attempt to form a government, which could challenge Benjamin Netanyahu's leadership. This move potentially provides Eisenkot with the necessary support to secure a majority in the Knesset. Separately, reports indicate that Israeli authorities have demolished a Palestinian Bedouin village to facilitate the expansion of a contentious settlement.
amharic: በእስራኤል የሚገኙ የዓረብ ፖለቲካ ፓርቲዎች፣ የጋራ ዝርዝር (Joint List) እና ራአም (Ra’am)፣ ጋዲ አይዘንኮት መንግስት እንዲመሰርቱ ድጋፋቸውን ሰጥተዋል። ይህ እርምጃ ቤንጃሚን ኔታንያሁ ለሚመሩት መንግስት ፈታኝ ሆኖ በክኔሴት ውስጥ አብላጫ ድምፅ እንዲያገኙ ሊረዳቸው ይችላል። በሌላ በኩል፣ እስራኤል አወዛጋቢ የሆነውን የኢ1 ህገ-ወጥ ሰፈራ ለማስፋፋት ስትል፣ የፍልስጤማውያን ቤዱዊን ማህበረሰብ የሚኖሩበትን መንደር ማፍረሷ ተዘግቧል።
oromo: Paartiileen siyaasaa Arabaa Israa'el keessa jiran, Joint List fi Ra'am, mootummaa hundeessuuf yaalii Gaadii Ayizankoot gochuutti jiruuf deggarsa kennaniiru. Tarkaanfiin kun Beenyaamiin Nataanyaahuuf dorgommii guddaa ta'uun, Ayizankoot paarlaamaa Israa'el keessatti sagalee caalmaa akka argatu gargaaruu danda'a. Kana malees, mootummaan Israa'el naannoo E1 jedhamu keessatti qubannaa seeraan alaa babal'isuuf jecha ganda warra Beeduwiin kan ta'an Falisxiinotaa diigee jira.

title: Two dead after bus crashes in France, officials say
english: A bus carrying 43 passengers crashed into a tree in eastern France on Friday morning, resulting in the deaths of a child and a young adult. The accident left three people in critical condition and several others with minor injuries, while the driver is currently hospitalized. Emergency crews and medical helicopters were deployed to the scene in the town of Lent to assist those involved in the wreckage.
amharic: አርብ ጠዋት በምስራቅ ፈረንሳይ 43 መንገደኞችን የጫነ አውቶብስ ዛፍ በመግጨቱ የሁለት ሰዎች ህይወት አልፏል። በአደጋው አንድ ህፃን እና አንድ ወጣት ሲሞቱ፣ ሶስት ሰዎች በአሳሳቢ ሁኔታ ላይ እንደሚገኙ እና ሌሎችም ቀላል ጉዳት እንደደረሰባቸው ተነግሯል። የአደጋ ጊዜ ሰራተኞች እና የህክምና ሄሊኮፕተሮች ተጎጂዎችን ለመርዳት ወደ ቦታው የተሰማሩ ሲሆን፣ የአውቶብሱ አሽከርካሪም ለህክምና ሆስፒታል ገብቷል።
oromo: Guyyaa Jimaataa ganama gara baha Faransaayiitti namoota 43 fe'ee deemaa ture, konkolaataan garee (bus) muka rukutee kufuunsaa hordofee namoonni lama lubbuun darbaniiru. Balaa kanaan ijoolleen tokko fi dargaggoon tokko du'anii, namoonni biroo sadii haala hamaa keessa akka jiran fi kanneen biroos miidhaa salphaa akka irra ga'e gabaasameera. Gareen gargaarsa hatattamaa fi xiyyaarri helikoptarii namoota miidhaman gargaaruuf gara iddoo balaa sanaa kan bobba'an yoo ta'u, ogeessi konkolaataa kunis yaalamaaf hospitaala galuu ibsameera.

title: Major construction ongoing near Iran missile bases, satellite images suggest
english: Recent satellite imagery reveals that Iran is actively repairing multiple military sites and constructing new facilities near key missile bases. Experts suggest that these activities, including the creation of underground structures, aim to shield Iranian missile production capabilities from future foreign air strikes. This ongoing expansion and repair work highlights Iran's efforts to rebuild its defense infrastructure following recent military engagements.
amharic: የቅርብ ጊዜ የሳተላይት ምስሎች እንደሚያሳዩት ኢራን በበርካታ ወታደራዊ ጣቢያዎቿ ላይ ጥገና እያደረገች እና በዋና ዋና ሚሳኤል ጣቢያዎቿ አቅራቢያ አዳዲስ ግንባታዎችን እያካሄደች ነው። ባለሙያዎች እንደሚናገሩት የምድር ውስጥ ግንባታዎችን ጨምሮ እነዚህ እንቅስቃሴዎች የኢራንን የሚሳኤል ማምረቻ አቅም ለወደፊት ሊሰነዘሩ ከሚችሉ የአየር ጥቃቶች ለመከላከል የታቀዱ ናቸው። ይህ ቀጣይነት ያለው የማስፋፊያ እና የጥገና ስራ ኢራን ከቅርብ ጊዜ ወታደራዊ ግጭቶች በኋላ የመከላከያ መሠረተ ልማቷን እንደገና ለመገንባት የምታደርገውን ጥረት ያሳያል።
oromo: Suuraaleen satalaayitii dhiheenya kana kaafaman akka agarsiisanitti, Iraan buufataalee waraanaa ishee hedduu irraatti suphaa gochaa fi buufataalee misaa'elaa gurguddoo ishee biratti ijaarsa haaraa gaggeessaa jirti. Ogeeyyiin akka jedhanitti, hojiin ijaarsa jala-lafaa dabalatee kun, dandeettii oomisha misaa'elaa Iraan weerara qilleensa irraa kan gara fuulduraatti ishee mudachuu danda'u irraa ittisuuf kan gargaaruudha. Ijaarsii fi suphaan kunis, Iraan walitti bu'iinsa waraanaa dhiheenya kanaa booda bu'uuraalee misoomaa waraana ishee deebisanii ijaaruuf carraaqqii gochaa jirtu ifa godha.

title: Court grants ex-Malaysian PM Najib house arrest after $12m royal pardon
english: Malaysia's former Prime Minister Najib Razak is transitioning from prison to house arrest after receiving a royal pardon and paying a $12 million fine raised through party crowdfunding. Although the legal order was issued, the attorney general has temporarily delayed the transfer to resolve questions regarding the pardon's conditions. Najib was originally jailed in 2022 for his involvement in the massive 1MDB state fund corruption scandal.
amharic: የማሌዢያ የቀድሞ ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር ናጂብ ራዛክ፣ በንጉሣዊ ይቅርታ እና በፓርቲያቸው የገንዘብ ማሰባሰቢያ በተከፈለ 12 ሚሊዮን ዶላር ቅጣት ከእስር ቤት ወደ ቤት እስር ለመዛወር ተዘጋጅተዋል። የፍርድ ቤት ትዕዛዝ ቢኖርም፣ የአገሪቱ ጠቅላይ ዓቃቤ ህግ የይቅርታውን ሁኔታ በተመለከተ አንዳንድ ሕጋዊ ማብራሪያዎች እንደሚያስፈልጉ በመግለጽ ዝውውሩን ለጊዜው አግዶታል። ናጂብ እ.ኤ.አ. በ2022 የታሰሩት የ1MDB የልማት ፈንድን በመዝረፍ በተከሰሱበት የሙስና ወንጀል ነው።
oromo: Muummeen Ministiraa duraanii Maalaysiyaa Naajiib Raazaak, dhiifama mootii argatanii fi maallaqa paartii isaaniin walitti qabamee kaffalameen gara mana hidhaatti jijjiiramuuf qophiirra jiru. Ajajni kun baatus, abbaan alangaa biyyattii haala dhiifamichaa irratti ibsa seeraa barbaachisuun walqabatee jijjiiramicha yeroodhaaf dhaabee jira. Naajiib bara 2022 kan hidhaman yakka malaammaltummaa fi saaminsa maallaqa invastimantii mootummaa 1MDB irratti hirmaachuu isaaniitiini.

title: Tech stock rout, driven by US AI fears, continues in Asian trading
english: Global stock markets experienced a significant decline following US midterm election results that raised concerns about potential AI regulations and slowed data center growth. Asian markets, including Japan and South Korea, saw sharp drops as investors worried that Democratic leadership might reverse the AI-focused policies of the previous administration. While trading authorities intervened to stabilize the markets, the massive sell-off highlights investor anxiety regarding the long-term profitability of AI infrastructure investments.
amharic: የአሜሪካ የመካከለኛ ዘመን ምርጫ ውጤት በአርቲፊሻል ኢንተለጀንስ (AI) ዘርፍ ላይ ጥብቅ ቁጥጥር ሊኖር ይችላል የሚል ስጋት በመፍጠሩ የቴክኖሎጂ ኩባንያዎች አክሲዮን ዋጋ በዓለም አቀፍ ደረጃ ወርዷል። እንደ ጃፓን እና ደቡብ ኮሪያ ያሉ የእስያ ገበያዎች ከፍተኛ የዋጋ ቅናሽ ታይቶባቸዋል፣ ይህም ባለሀብቶች ቀደም ሲል የነበሩ የቴክኖሎጂ ማበረታቻዎች ሊቀየሩ ይችላሉ በሚል መደናገጣቸውን ያሳያል። የገበያ ተቆጣጣሪዎች ውድቀቱን ለመግታት ቢሞክሩም፣ የኢንቨስትመንት ትርፋማነት ላይ ያለው ጥርጣሬ በቴክኖሎጂ ዘርፉ ላይ ከፍተኛ ተጽዕኖ ፈጥሯል።
oromo: Bu'aan filannoo giddu-galeessa Amerikaa teknolojii AI irratti qajeelfamni cimaan akka hojiirra ooluufi ijaarsi giddu-galeessa daataa akka suuta jedhu yaaddoo uumee jira. Kunis gabaa adunyaa keessattuu kanneen Eeshiyaa keessatti gatii aksiyoonaa teknoloojii gadi buusee jira. Abbootiin qabeenyaa siyaasni haaraa kun guddina teknoloojii AI irratti dhiibbaa uuma jedhanii sodaachaa jiru. Abbootiin aangoo gabaa balaa kana ittisuuf carraaqqii godhanis, bu'aan teknoloojii kanaa irratti amanamummaan inni duraa hir'achuu isaatiin gabaan kun miidhamuu danda'eera.

title: UK jailing of Indian sailor over Russia sanctions sets off ‘perfect storm’
english: Captain Ajay Pant, an Indian merchant navy officer, has been detained in the UK after his oil tanker was seized by British forces for allegedly violating sanctions against Russia. While European nations have intercepted similar 'shadow' fleet vessels before, this marks the first time a captain has been personally jailed for such activities. The case has sparked significant controversy, with maritime rights groups arguing that punishing individual sailors for the actions of their employers sets a dangerous and unfair legal precedent.
amharic: የህንድ የንግድ መርከብ ካፒቴን የሆኑት አጃይ ፓንት፣ መርከባቸው የሩሲያን ማዕቀብ ጥሳለች በሚል በብሪታንያ ኃይሎች ከተያዘች በኋላ በእስር ላይ ይገኛሉ። ምንም እንኳን የአውሮፓ ሀገራት ከዚህ ቀደም የሩሲያ ማዕቀብን የሚጥሱ መርከቦችን ቢይዙም፣ አንድን መርከበኛ ለዚሁ ተግባር በግል ሲያስሩ ይህ የመጀመሪያው ነው። የባህር ላይ መብት ተሟጋቾች፣ የአሰሪዎችን ስህተት በግለሰብ መርከበኞች ላይ መጫን አደገኛ እና ኢ-ፍትሃዊ የህግ አሰራር እንደሆነ በመግለጽ ጉዳዩን እያወገዙት ነው።
oromo: Ajay Pant kan jedhaman kabitini doonii Indiyaa, dooniin isaanii gurgurtaa boba’aa biyya Raashiyaa irratti kaayame cabsiteetti shakkamuudhaan mootummaa UK tiin qabamaniiru. Biyyoonni Awurooppaa dooniiwwan seera cabsan kana dura qabachaa turus, kun garuu kabitii doonii tokko dhuunfaatti hidhuun yeroo jalqabaati. Gareewwan mirga galaanaatti hojjetanii fi abbootiin seeraa, yakka abboota hojii isaaniitiif hojjettoota adabuun seera haaraa fi sirrii hin taane akka uumu ibsuun mormii guddaa kaasaniiru.

title: Abdul El-Sayed did not have to become less Muslim to win
english: Abdul El-Sayed has made history by becoming the first Muslim elected to the United States Senate after winning his race in Michigan. His successful campaign demonstrates that Muslim American candidates can achieve political victory without compromising their faith, identity, or principles. Supporters view his win as a source of genuine hope and pride, noting his long-standing connection to his community.
amharic: አብዱል ኤል-ሳየድ በቺካጎ ግዛት ባሸነፉት ምርጫ በአሜሪካ ሴኔት ለመጀመሪያ ጊዜ የተመረጡ ሙስሊም ሆነው ታሪክ ሰርተዋል። የእሳቸው የድል ጉዞ ሙስሊም አሜሪካዊያን እምነታቸውን፣ ማንነታቸውን እና መርሆቻቸውን ሳይለቁ በፖለቲካው ዓለም ስኬታማ መሆን እንደሚችሉ ያሳያል። ደጋፊዎቻቸው ከማህበረሰባቸው ጋር ያላቸውን የቆየ ትስስር በማድነቅ ይህ ድል ትልቅ ተስፋ እና ኩራት እንደፈጠረላቸው ይናገራሉ።
oromo: Abdul El-Sayed muummicha senetii Ameerikaa ta'ee filatamee Muslima duraa ta'uudhaan seenaa hojjateera. Injifannoon isaa kun Muslimoonni Ameerikaa amantii fi eenyummaa isaanii utuu hin dhiisiin siyaasa keessatti milkaa'uu akka danda'an kan mirkaneessuudha. Deeggartoonni isaa hawaasa isaa waliin qabuun cimaa ta'uu isaa ibsaa, injifannoon isaa kun abdii fi boona guddaa akka uume himu.

title: Can America ever return to pre-Trump politics?
english: Following a decade of divisive political rhetoric introduced by Donald Trump, recent American midterm elections suggest voters are becoming weary of aggressive, partisan conflict. While some political victories reflect a desire for more unifying leadership, analysts remain uncertain if the nation can move past the lasting impact of this confrontational era. The style of politics that prioritizes entertainment and hostility over traditional discourse has significantly altered the country's social and political landscape.
amharic: ዶናልድ ትራምፕ ላለፉት አስር ዓመታት ያስተዋወቁት ተከፋፋይ የፖለቲካ ንግግሮች አሜሪካውያንን አድክመዋል፣ የቅርብ ጊዜዎቹ የምርጫ ውጤቶችም ይህንን አዝማሚያ ያሳያሉ። አንዳንድ የምርጫ ውጤቶች ህዝቡ አንድነትን የሚፈልግ መሪ እንደሚሻ ያሳዩ ቢሆንም፣ አገሪቱ ከዚህ የጠላትነት ፖለቲካ ሙሉ በሙሉ ለመላቀቅ መቸገሯ እውን ነው። ይህ በፖለቲካ ውስጥ መዝናኛን እና ግጭትን ከስርአት ያስቀደመው አካሄድ የአሜሪካን ማህበራዊ እና የፖለቲካ አሻራ በቋሚነት የቀየረው ይመስላል።
oromo: Donald Trump waggoota kudhan darbaniif siyaasa wal-qoodinsa irratti hundaa'e fiduun isaa ummata Ameerikaa kan nuffisiise yoo ta'u, bu'aan filannoo darbes kana hubachiisa. Injifannoon siyaasaa tokko tokko kanneen tokkummaa barbaadan kan calaqqisan ta'us, biyyattiin dhiibbaa siyaasa wal-dhabdee kanaa keessaa ba'uuf hangam akka dandeessu mirkanaa'aa miti. Akkaataan siyaasaa kun kabaja irra wal-xiinsuu fi bashannansiisuu kan dursu waan ta'eef, sadarkaa hawaasummaa fi siyaasaa biyyattii irratti jijjiirama guddaa fideera.

title: Global tech stocks plunge as US midterms add to AI slowdown fears
english: Global tech stocks suffered a massive decline as investors reacted to Democratic victories in the US midterm elections, which included platforms aimed at slowing artificial intelligence development. Major markets in the US and Asia plummeted, with chip manufacturers seeing particularly sharp losses due to fears that new regulations will stall AI infrastructure growth. This downturn reflects ongoing uncertainty about whether the high levels of investment in AI technology will ultimately prove profitable.
amharic: በአሜሪካ የኮንግረስ መካከለኛ ምርጫ የዴሞክራቲክ ፓርቲ ማሸነፍና በሰው ሰራሽ አስተውሎት (AI) እድገት ላይ ሊጣል የሚችለው ገደብ በዓለም አቀፍ የቴክኖሎጂ ኩባንያዎች አክሲዮኖች ላይ ከፍተኛ ውድቀት አስከትሏል። በተለይም በቺፕ ማምረቻ እና በቴክኖሎጂ ዘርፍ የተሰማሩ ተቋማት ገበያ በከፍተኛ ሁኔታ ቀንሷል። ይህ የዋጋ መቀነስ የቴክኖሎጂ ኩባንያዎች ለ AI ቴክኖሎጂ የሚያወጡት ከፍተኛ ወጪ አዋጭነቱ አጠያያቂ መሆኑን ያሳያል።
oromo: Bu'aan filannoo giddu-galeessa Ameerikaa keessatti Paartiin Demokiraatotaa injifachuu fi haala itti guddina teknooloojii 'Artificial Intelligence' (AI) daangeessuu danda'u jedhamee sodaatamuun gabaa teknooloojii addunyaa irratti miidhaa guddaa geessiseera. Qoodiwwan kampaniiwwan teknooloojii gurguddaa fi oomishtoota chipii irratti kufuun, gabaan isaa hanga tiriliyoona 2.5 gahuuf gadi bu'eera. Kunis invastimantii gurguddaa teknooloojii AI irratti godhamaa jiru bu'aa buusuu danda'a moo hin danda'u kan jedhu yaaddoo uumeera.

title: Trump signs order preventing future presidents from changing Oval Office
english: President Donald Trump has signed an executive order designating the Oval Office as a national monument to prevent future leaders from making significant structural changes to the room. While the president claims this move protects the office's historic integrity, he still allows for minor redecorating and necessary maintenance. This decision follows Trump's own extensive renovations, including adding gold features and other cosmetic updates during his second term.
amharic: ፕሬዝዳንት ዶናልድ ትራምፕ የወደፊት መሪዎች በኦቫል ኦፊስ ላይ ከፍተኛ መዋቅራዊ ለውጦችን እንዳያደርጉ የሚከለክል አስፈፃሚ ትዕዛዝ ፈርመዋል። ይህ ትዕዛዝ ቢሮውን እንደ ብሔራዊ መታሰቢያ በመቁጠር የህንፃውን ታሪካዊ ይዘት ለመጠበቅ ያለመ መሆኑን ገልጸዋል። ሆኖም ትዕዛዙ አስፈላጊ የሆኑ የጥገና ሥራዎችን እና የውስጥ ዲዛይን ለውጦችን አይከለክልም።
oromo: Pireezidaanti Doonald Traamp, dura taa'onni gara fuulduraa mana hojii 'Oval Office' irratti jijjiirama guddaa akka hin godhanne dhowwuu labsii tokko mallatteessaniiru. Labsiin kun mana hojichaa akka siidaa biyyaalessatti beekamee akka eegamu kan taasisu yoo ta'u, seenaa isaa eeguuf yaadamee kan ba'e ta'uu ibsameera. Haata'u malee, labsiin kun sirreeffama xixiqqoo fi suphaa barbaachisaa ta'e gochuu irraa kan dhowwu miti.

title: White House denies Hegseth and Rubio to leave jobs after Republican election losses
english: The White House has officially dismissed speculation that Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth and Secretary of State Marco Rubio are resigning following recent Republican election defeats. While Hegseth faces political pressure and potential impeachment threats due to the ongoing war in Iran, both he and President Trump have rejected these calls. Similarly, Rubio has confirmed his commitment to staying in his position, with the administration labeling rumors of his departure as false.
amharic: የዋይት ሃውስ አስተዳደር የመከላከያ ሚኒስትሩ ፒት ሄግሴዝ እና የውጭ ጉዳይ ሚኒስትሩ ማርኮ ሩቢዮ በምርጫ ሽንፈቱ ምክንያት ከስልጣናቸው እንደሚለቁ የሚናፈሱትን ወሬዎች አስተባብሏል። ሄግሴዝ በኢራን ጦርነት አያያዝ ምክንያት ከፍተኛ ጫና እና የእምነት ማጣት ጥያቄዎች ቢገጥሙትም፣ እርሱም ሆነ ፕሬዚዳንት ትራምፕ እነዚህን ክሶች ውድቅ አድርገውታል። በተመሳሳይ፣ ማርኮ ሩቢዮ ስልጣናቸውን የመልቀቅ እቅድ እንደሌላቸው ገልጸው፣ አስተዳደሩም ስለ መውጣታቸው የሚነገሩ ዘገባዎች መሰረት የሌላቸው መሆናቸውን አረጋግጧል።
oromo: Mana Maree Adii (White House) gabaasawwan ministirri ittisa biyyaa Pete Hegseth fi ministirri dhimma alaa Marco Rubio mo'atamuu paartii Rippabilikaanootaatiin booda hojii gadhiisuuf jiru jedhaman haaleera. Hegseth waraana Iraan irratti gaggeeffamaa jiruun walqabatee dhiibbaa siyaasaa fi sodaannoo aangoo irraa ari'amuu kan mudate ta'us, inni fi pirezidaant Traamp gabaasawwan kana fudhatama dhabsiisaniiru. Akkasumas, Rubio aangoo isaa itti fufuuf murteesseera; mootummaanis oduun waa'ee isaanii dhiheenyatti faca'aa jiru dhara ta'uu ibseera.

title: Pope begins lengthy trip to Latin America weeks after lung cancer surgery
english: Pope Leo XIV has embarked on a 12-day tour of Latin America, including stops in Uruguay, Argentina, and Peru, only three weeks after undergoing surgery for lung cancer. The Vatican confirmed the Pope is in good health and maintains a full schedule, noting that his cancer has not spread. This extensive trip marks a significant return to his duties, particularly his visit to Peru where he previously served as a priest.
amharic: ርዕሰ ሊቃነ ጳጳሳት ሊዮ አሥራ አራተኛ ለሳንባ ካንሰር ቀዶ ጥገና ከተደረገላቸው በሦስት ሳምንት ጊዜ ውስጥ ወደ ላቲን አሜሪካ የአስራ ሁለት ቀናት ጉዞ ጀምረዋል። ቫቲካን እንደገለጸችው የጳጳሱ የጤና ሁኔታ ጥሩ በመሆኑ ምንም አይነት ልዩ የህክምና ጥንቃቄ ሳያስፈልጋቸው ጉዞውን ቀጥለዋል። ጉዞው ኡራጓይን፣ አርጀንቲናን እና ፔሩን የሚያካትት ሲሆን፣ ጳጳሱ ቀደም ሲል ካህን ሆነው ባገለገሉባት ፔሩ ላይ የሚያደርጉት ጉብኝት ልዩ ትኩረት ተሰጥቶታል።
oromo: Pappasii Liyo 14ffaan baqaqaa sombaatiin walqabatee guyyoota muraasa dura qophii fayyaa erga godhatanii booda, yeroo ammaa imala guyyoota 12f t，uu gara biyyoota Laatin Ameerikaa jalqabaniiru. Vaatikaan akka ibsitetti, fayyaan isaanii cimaa fi imala isaanii guutuuf ga’umsa kan qaban ta’uu mirkaneessiteetti. Imalli kun biyyoota Urugwaay, Arjantiinaa fi Peeruu kan dabalatu yoo ta’u, keessattuu biyya Peeruu dursee lubaan itti tajaajilaa ture deebi’anii daawwachuun isaanii jaallatamoo ta’eera.

title: Iran’s security chief meets Putin, delivers message from Khamenei
english: Iranian security official Mohsen Rezaei traveled to Moscow to meet President Vladimir Putin and deliver a personal letter from Supreme Leader Mojtaba Khamenei. The discussions primarily focused on regional security strategies, ending the ongoing conflict with the US and Israel, and strengthening energy ties between the two nations. This high-level meeting occurs amidst broader international diplomatic initiatives aimed at resolving the war and addressing the future of the Strait of Hormuz.
amharic: የኢራን ከፍተኛ የደህንነት ባለሥልጣን ሞህሰን ረዛኢ በሞስኮ ከፕሬዝዳንት ቭላድሚር ፑቲን ጋር በመገናኘት ከጠቅላይ መሪ ሞጅታባ ካሜኒ የተላከ ደብዳቤ አስረክበዋል። ውይይታቸው በዋናነት በክልሉ የጸጥታ ጉዳዮች፣ ከአሜሪካ እና እስራኤል ጋር እየተካሄደ ያለውን ጦርነት ለማቆም በሚቻልባቸው መንገዶች እንዲሁም በሁለቱ አገራት መካከል ያለውን የኢነርጂ ትብብር ማጠናከር ላይ ያተኮረ ነበር። ይህ ከፍተኛ ደረጃ ያለው ስብሰባ የተካሄደው ጦርነቱን ለማቆም እና የሆርሙዝ ስትሬትን የወደፊት ዕጣ ፈንታ ለመወሰን በሚደረጉ ዓለም አቀፍ ዲፕሎማሲያዊ ጥረቶች መካከል ነው።
oromo: Hoggantoonni nageenyaa Iraan Mohsen Reza'ii magaala Moskoo deemun Pirezidaant Vladimir Putin waliin walarguun xalayaa hogganaa olaanaa Mojtaba Khamenei irraa ergames akka isaaniif kennan beekameera. Mariin isaanii inni guddaan nageenya naannichaa, waraana Ameerikaa fi Israa'el waliin jiru xumuruu, akkasumas hariiroo anniisaa biyyoota lamaan gidduu jiru cimsuurratti xiyyeeffateera. Walgahii sadarkaa olaanaa kana kan taasifame yeroo waraana kana xumuruu fi dhimma harka ganda Hormuz irratti carraaqqii dippilomaasii addunyaa bal'aan taasifamaa jiru keessatti.

title: Gaza turns discarded cooking pots into seawalls
english: To prepare for the coming winter, aid organizations in Gaza are repurposing broken cooking pots to build temporary seawalls. These structures are designed to safeguard schools and residential shelters from potential flooding caused by the ocean. This creative initiative serves as a vital defense mechanism to protect local infrastructure and vulnerable communities.
amharic: በጋዛ የሚገኙ የረድኤት ድርጅቶች መጪውን የክረምት ወራት ታሳቢ በማድረግ፣ የተበላሹ የማብሰያ ድስት ዕቃዎችን በመጠቀም ጊዜያዊ የባህር ዳርቻ መከላከያ ግድቦችን እየገነቡ ነው። እነዚህ ግንባታዎች ትምህርት ቤቶችን እና መኖሪያ ቤቶችን ከጎርፍ አደጋ ለመጠበቅ ታስበው የተሰሩ ናቸው። ይህ ፈጠራ የተሞላበት እርምጃ የአካባቢውን መሰረተ ልማቶች እና ነዋሪዎችን ከአደጋ ለመታደግ ይረዳል።
oromo: Gaza keessatti dhaabbileen gargaarsaa gannaan dhufuuf jiruun dura akka isaan hin miidhamneef, okkoteewwan caban fayyadamuudhaan dallaa bishaan galaanaa ittisu ijaaraa jiru. Ijaarsi kun manneen barnootaa fi bakka jireenyaa lolaa irraa ittisuuf kan gargaaru dha. Tarkaanfiin uumamaa kun bu'uuraalee misoomaa fi uummata miidhamuu danda'an balaa irraa eeguuf gumaacha guddaa qaba.

title: California governor commutes sentences of more than 500 people on death row
english: California Governor Gavin Newsom has commuted the death sentences of all 548 inmates on the state's death row, marking the largest mass clemency in U.S. history. These individuals will now serve life in prison without the chance of parole instead of facing execution. The Governor explained that this decision is based on moral objections to the death penalty, the high financial cost of maintaining the system, and concerns regarding potential human error in legal proceedings.
amharic: የካሊፎርኒያ ገዢ ጋቪን ኒውሶም በግዛቲቱ በሞት ፍርድ ላይ የነበሩ 548 እስረኞችን ቅጣት ወደ ዕድሜ ልክ እስራት ቀይረውታል። ይህ ውሳኔ በአሜሪካ ታሪክ ትልቁ የቅጣት ማቅለያ ሆኖ ተመዝግቧል። ገዢው ይህንን እርምጃ የወሰዱት በሞት ቅጣት ላይ ባላቸው የሥነ-ምግባር ተቃውሞ፣ የሥርዓቱ ከፍተኛ ወጪ እና በሕግ ሂደት ውስጥ ሊከሰት የሚችል የፍትህ መጓደል ስጋት በመነሳት ነው።
oromo: Gootuun Kaliforniyaa Gavin Newsom, namoota 548 ta'an kanneen iddoo adabbii du'aatti turan hunda gara hidhaa umrii guutuutti jijjiiranii jiru. Murtoon kun seenaa Ameerikaa keessatti dhiifama guddaa ta'ee kan galmeeffame dha. Gootuun kun murtee kana kan dabarsan, adabbiin du'aa sirrii akka hin taane, baasii guddaa akka qabu fi dogoggorri qulqullinaa seeraa keessatti uumamu akka danda'u ibsuudhaan dha.

title: Israeli settlers set fire to Palestinian olive grove near Ramallah
english: Israeli settlers recently started fires that damaged olive trees belonging to Palestinian farmers in the village of Burqa, located near Ramallah. Local farmers reported that they were prevented from putting out the flames by Israeli military forces. This incident has caused significant concern regarding the protection of Palestinian agricultural property.
amharic: የእስራኤል ሰፈራ ነዋሪዎች በርማላህ አቅራቢያ በሚገኘው የቡርቃ መንደር የፍልስጤም ገበሬዎች የሆኑ የዘይቱን ዛፎች በእሳት አቃጠሉ። የሀገር ውስጥ ገበሬዎች የእስራኤል ወታደራዊ ኃይሎች እሳቱን እንዳያጠፉ እንደከለከሏቸው ገልጸዋል። ይህ ክስተት በፍልስጤማውያን የግብርና መሬቶች ደህንነት ላይ ከፍተኛ ስጋት ፈጥሯል።
oromo: Warreen buufata isaanitti qubatan kan Israa'el, magaalaa Ramallaah bira jirtu Burqaa keessatti muka ejersa kan qonnaan bulaa warra Falasxiin ta'e ibiddan gubaniiru. Qonnaan bultoonni naannichaa akka jedhanitti, waraanni Israa'el ibidda sana akka hin dhaamsine isaan dhowwatan. Gochi kun qabeenya qonnaa warra Falasxiin irratti miidhaa geessisuun isaa yaaddoo guddaa uumera.

title: Turkiye’s parliament ratifies Mecca defence agreement
english: The Turkish parliament has approved a defense agreement with Saudi Arabia and Pakistan, pledging mutual military support against external aggression. The pact includes a collective defense clause similar to NATO's, requiring members to assist each other if attacked. This move follows ongoing security challenges in the region, particularly involving Houthi rebels, and potentially increases Turkey's military involvement in Saudi Arabia.
amharic: የቱርክ ፓርላማ ከሳውዲ አረቢያ እና ከፓኪስታን ጋር የተደረገ የመከላከያ ስምምነትን አጽድቋል፣ ይህም አባል ሀገራት በውጭ ጥቃት ሲደርስባቸው የጋራ ወታደራዊ ድጋፍ ለማድረግ ቃል ገብተዋል። ስምምነቱ የኔቶን የጋራ መከላከያ አንቀጽ የሚመስል ድንጋጌ የያዘ ሲሆን፣ ማንኛውም አባል ጥቃት ቢደርስበት ሌሎቹ ወዲያውኑ ድጋፍ እንዲያደርጉ ያስገድዳል። ይህ ውሳኔ በሳውዲ አረቢያ ላይ እየደረሱ ያሉ የሁቲ አማጽያን ጥቃቶችን ተከትሎ የመጣ ሲሆን፣ ቱርክ በክልሉ ያላትን ወታደራዊ ተሳትፎ ሊጨምር ይችላል።
oromo: Parlamaan Turkiyaa waliigaltee ittisaa kan Saudii Arabiyaa fi Paakistaan waliin mallatteesse raggaaseera, waliigalteen kunis biyyoonni miseensa ta'an yoo weerara biyya alaa mudatan wal gargaaruuf kan dirqaman ta'uu ibsa. Waliigalteen kun akkaataa yaada NATO irraa fudhatameen, miseensota keessaa tokko yoo haleelame biyyoonni kaan hatattamaan gargaarsa akka godhan dirqisiisa. Tarkaanfiin kun rakkoo nageenyaa humnoota Huutii irraa Saudii Arabiyaa mudachaa jiru hordofee kan dhufe yoo ta'u, Turkiyaan qindoomina waraanaa naannichaa keessatti qabdu akka dabaluuf kan gargaaruudha.

title: Hoax bomb threats target European airlines and airports for second time in a week
english: European airports and airlines faced a wave of false bomb threats for the second time this week, forcing diversions and emergency security responses across multiple countries. British officials have labeled these incidents as malicious hoaxes after extensive searches confirmed that no explosives were present. While a group associated with an extremist Russian movement has claimed responsibility, authorities are still investigating the source and potential motives behind these widespread disruptions.
amharic: በአውሮፓ የሚገኙ አውሮፕላን ማረፊያዎች እና አየር መንገዶች በዚህ ሳምንት ለሁለተኛ ጊዜ በሐሰተኛ የቦምብ ማስፈራሪያዎች ተጠቂ ሆነዋል። በዚህም ምክንያት በበርካታ ሀገራት የሚገኙ በረራዎች እንዲዘገዩ ወይም ወደ ሌሎች አቅጣጫዎች እንዲዞሩ ተደርገዋል። የብሪታንያ ባለስልጣናት ማስፈራሪያዎቹ ሙሉ በሙሉ የሐሰት መሆናቸውን ያረጋገጡ ሲሆን፣ እስካሁን ምንም አይነት ፈንጂ አልተገኘም።
oromo: Buufataalee xiyyaaraa fi dhaabbilee xiyyaaraa Awurooppaa keessa jiran irratti torbee kana keessatti yeroo lammaffaaf walitti aansuun sodaachisni boombii sobaa mudateera. Gochi kun xiyyaarota hedduu gara bakka biraatti akka deebi'an ykn dirqama akka qubatan dirqisiiseera. Aangeyyoonni Biritish akka ibsanitti, qorannoon gaggeeffameen boombii fi wantoota balaa geessisan kamiyyuu waan hin argamneef, sodaachisni kun kijiba akka ta'e mirkanaa'eera.

title: Who could be behind hoax bomb threats to European air travel?
english: European aviation has recently faced a wave of coordinated hoax bomb threats that forced several emergency landings and security responses. While there is no definitive proof yet, many experts suspect these disruptions are part of a broader campaign of hybrid warfare orchestrated by Russia. These incidents follow a pattern of other suspicious activities across Europe, which some believe are intended to retaliate against Western support for Ukraine.
amharic: በቅርቡ በአውሮፓ አየር መንገዶች ላይ በተደጋጋሚ የደረሱ የቦምብ ማስፈራሪያዎች የሐሰት መሆናቸው ተረጋግጧል፤ ሆኖም እነዚህ ድርጊቶች በበረራ መርሃ ግብሮች ላይ መስተጓጎል ፈጥረዋል። ምንም እንኳን ተጠያቂው አካል በግልጽ ባይታወቅም፣ ብዙዎች እነዚህን የተቀናጁ ጥቃቶች ሩሲያ በምዕራባውያን ላይ በምትከፍተው የተዳቀለ የጦርነት ስልት አካል አድርገው ይወስዷቸዋል። ይህ ድርጊት ምናልባትም ምዕራባውያን ለዩክሬን እያደረጉ ላለው ድጋፍ የመበቀያ መንገድ ሊሆን እንደሚችል ተገምቷል።
oromo: ይህንን ሳምንት በአውሮፓ አየር ማረፊያዎች ላይ የተፈጸሙ ተከታታይ የቦምብ ማስፈራሪያዎች የሐሰት እንደነበሩ ተረጋግጧል። ምንም እንኳን ለዚህ ድርጊት በግልጽ ተጠያቂ የሆነ አካል ባይኖርም፣ ብዙ ባለሙያዎች እነዚህ የተቀናጁ ጥቃቶች በሩሲያ የሚመሩ የዘመናዊ ጦርነት ስልቶች አካል ሊሆኑ እንደሚችሉ ይገምታሉ። እነዚህ ድርጊቶች ምዕራባውያን አገራት ለዩክሬን እያደረጉት ላለው ድጋፍ አጸፋዊ ምላሽ ለመስጠት የታለመ ሊሆን እንደሚችል ይጠረጠራል።

title: California governor commutes sentences for state's 548 death row inmates
english: California Governor Gavin Newsom has commuted the death sentences of all 548 inmates on the state's death row, changing their punishment to life in prison without parole. Newsom stated that state-sanctioned executions contradict California's core values and noted that the legal system is often unfairly applied. Although the state has not conducted an execution since 2006, this decision formally ends the practice as Newsom prepares to leave office.
amharic: የካሊፎርኒያ ገዢ ጋቪን ኒውሰም በግዛቲቱ በሞት ፍርድ ላይ የሚገኙትን 548 እስረኞች የቅጣት ውሳኔ ወደ እድሜ ልክ እስራት ቀይረውታል። ገዢው የሞት ቅጣት የካሊፎርኒያን እሴቶች የሚፃረር እና ፍትሃዊ ያልሆነ አሰራር መሆኑን በመግለፅ ውሳኔውን ወስነዋል። ካሊፎርኒያ ከ2006 ጀምሮ ምንም አይነት የሞት ቅጣት አላከናወነችም፤ ይህ ውሳኔም ከስልጣን ለመልቀቅ በተዘጋጁት ገዢው የመጨረሻ እርምጃዎች አንዱ ነው።
oromo: Gootichi naannoo Kaalifoorniyaa Gavin Newsom murtee du'aa hidhattoota 548 ta'an gara hidhaa umrii guutuutti jijjiireera. Newsom duuti mootummaan raawwatamu qixaafi qulqullina kan hin qabne akkasumas ilaalcha naannichaa kan mormu ta'uu ibseera. Kaalifoorniyaan bara 2006 irraa eegalee nam tokko illee waan hin ajjeesineef, murteen kun duula du'aa kana seeraan dhaabuuf kan gargaaruudha.

title: Generation Z and diversity redefine US politics in groundbreaking election
english: The 2026 US midterm elections saw a historic milestone as Melat Kiros became the first Generation Z woman elected to Congress. Young voters shifted their support back toward the Democratic Party, representing a significant turnaround from their voting patterns in 2024. Although younger voters make up a small portion of the overall electorate, their clear dissatisfaction with the current national leadership has signaled a new era of diverse and youthful political representation.
amharic: የ2026 የአሜሪካ የመካከለኛ ዘመን ምርጫ መላት ኪሮስ ወደ ኮንግረስ የተመረጠች የመጀመሪያዋ የጄኔሬሽን ዜድ ሴት በመሆን ታሪካዊ ምዕራፍ ተመዝግቧል። ወጣት መራጮች ድጋፋቸውን እንደገና ለዴሞክራቲክ ፓርቲ በመስጠት ከ2024 ምርጫ በተለየ መልኩ ለውጥ አሳይተዋል። ምንም እንኳን ወጣቶች በአጠቃላይ መራጮች ውስጥ አነስተኛ ድርሻ ቢኖራቸውም፣ በአገሪቱ ወቅታዊ አመራር ላይ ያላቸው ቅሬታ አዲስ እና የተለያየ ተሳትፎ ያለው የፖለቲካ ዘመን መጀመሩን ያሳያል።
oromo: Filannoo giddu-galeessa waggaa 2026 kan Amerikaa keessatti, Melat Kiros dubartii dhaloota 'Generation Z' keessaa gara Kongiresiitti filatamte jalqabaa taatee seenaa hojjatteetti. Dargaggoonni sagalee isaanii irra deebi'anii gara Paartii Dimokiraataatti jijjiiruun, akkaataa sagalee itti kennan bara 2024 irraa garaagarummaa guddaa agarsiisaniiru. Dargaggoonni hirmaattota filannoo waliigalaa keessatti xiqqaatu illee, hogganummaa biyyattii amma jiru irratti gammadummaa dhabuun isaanii, bakka bu'iinsa siyaasaa haaraa fi gara garaa ta'e kan agarsiisuudha.

title: South Africa’s ANC on track for new lows in local polls
english: South Africa’s African National Congress (ANC) is seeing its support decline further in the latest municipal elections, currently polling around 32 percent. The party has faced significant backlash due to poor public service delivery, frequent power outages, and ongoing corruption concerns. With voter turnout higher than in previous local polls, these results indicate a growing shift in voter preference ahead of the 2029 national elections.
amharic: በደቡብ አፍሪካ በተካሄደው የአካባቢ ምርጫ የአገሪቱ ገዢ ፓርቲ የሆነው አፍሪካን ናሽናል ኮንግረስ (ANC) ድጋፉ በከፍተኛ ሁኔታ እየቀነሰ መምጣቱ ታይቷል። ፓርቲው በመሰረተ ልማት አቅርቦት ጉድለት፣ በኃይል መቆራረጥ እና በሙስና ክሶች ምክንያት የህዝብ ተቃውሞ ገጥሞታል። ከቀድሞው ምርጫ በተሻለ ሁኔታ የታየው የህዝብ ተሳትፎ፣ በ2029 ለሚካሄደው አጠቃላይ ምርጫ አዲስ የፖለቲካ አቅጣጫን የሚያመላክት ሆኗል።
oromo: Filannoo magaalotaa biyya Afrikaa Kibbaatti geggeeffameen, paartiin biyya bulchaa jiru African National Congress (ANC) deggarsa isaa gadi bu'aa jiraachuu argisiiseera. Paartiin kun rakkoolee tajaajila hawaasaa, hir'ina ibsaa fi komii malaammaltummaa irratti ka'eef balaaleffatamuu irraa kan ka'e, humni isaa xiqqaachaa dhufeera. Hirmaattonni filannoo dabaluun isaanii, filannoo biyyoolessaa bara 2029 duratti jijjiiramni siyaasaa guddaan jiraachuu kan agarsiisuudha.

title: Spanish footballer Jesus de Miguel mourned by family and friends
english: Spanish football player Jesus de Miguel has passed away at the age of 30. The striker suffered a fatal cardiac arrest after colliding with another player during a second-division match. His family and friends have gathered to mourn him following his funeral service.
amharic: የስፔኑ እግር ኳስ ተጫዋች ጄሱስ ዲ ሚጌል በ30 ዓመቱ ከዚህ ዓለም በሞት ተለይቷል። አጥቂው በሁለተኛው ዲቪዚዮን ጨዋታ ወቅት ከሌላ ተጫዋች ጋር በተጋጨበት ወቅት በደረሰበት የልብ ድካም ህይወቱ አልፏል። የቀብር ስነ ስርዓቱ ከተፈጸመ በኋላ ቤተሰቦቹ እና ወዳጅ ዘመዶቹ በሀዘን ላይ ይገኛሉ።
oromo: Taphataan kubbaa miilaa Ispeen Jeesus di Miigeel umurii waggaa 30tti du'aan boqoteera. Xiyyabdaan kun tapha liigii lammaffaa irratti yeroo taphatoota biroo wajjin walitti bu'anitti rakkoo onnee mudatee lubbuun isaa darbeera. Hawaasni isaa fi firoonni isaa sirna awwaalchaa booda gadda cimaa keessa jiru.

title: Israeli demolitions displace more than 100 Palestinians in Biddu
english: Israeli forces recently tore down five residential buildings in the West Bank town of Biddu, located northwest of Jerusalem. This operation resulted in over 100 Palestinians losing their homes. Local residents reported that the demolition occurred suddenly without prior notice, even though there were active legal efforts to stop the action.
amharic: የእስራኤል ኃይሎች በኢየሩሳሌም ሰሜናዊ ምዕራብ በሚገኘው የቢዱ ከተማ ውስጥ አምስት መኖሪያ ቤቶችን አፍርሰዋል። በዚህ ድርጊት ከ100 በላይ ፍልስጤማውያን መፈናቀላቸውን እና መጠለያ ማጣታቸውን ዘገባዎች ያሳያሉ። የከተማዋ ነዋሪዎች እንደገለጹት፣ ቤቶቹ የፈረሱት ምንም ዓይነት ቅድመ ማስጠንቀቂያ ሳይሰጥባቸው ነው፤ ምንም እንኳን ቤቶቹን ለማዳን የሕግ ሂደቶች ተጀምረው ነበር።
oromo: Humnootni Israa'el magaalaa Biddoo, kibba-lixaa Yerusaalemitti argamtutti manneen jireenyaa shan diiganiiru. Gocha kanaan kan ka'e, namootni Pilaastinii 100 ol ta'an mana isaanii dhabanii qe'eerraa buqqa'aniiru. Jiraattonni akka jedhanitti, diigamuu manneen kanaa kan raawwatame akeekkachiisa tokko malee yoo ta'u, manneen kunneen ittisuuf carraaqqii seeraa godhamaa ture illee osoo hin milkaa'in hafeera.

title: Hoax bomb threats force emergency landings, evacuations across Europe
english: Numerous flights across Europe have been severely disrupted due to a series of false bomb threats. Authorities were forced to conduct emergency landings and evacuations for at least 27 aircraft. After thorough inspections, officials confirmed that these threats were hoaxes and no danger was found.
amharic: በአውሮፓ በተከታታይ የደረሱ የቦምብ ማስፈራሪያዎች የብዙ በረራዎችን መስተጓጎል አስከትለዋል። ቢያንስ 27 አውሮፕላኖች በድንገተኛ ሁኔታ እንዲያርፉ እና ተሳፋሪዎች እንዲለቀቁ ተደርጓል። ባለሥልጣናት ባደረጉት ጥልቅ ምርመራ ማስፈራሪያዎቹ ሀሰተኛ መሆናቸውን እና ምንም አይነት አደጋ እንደሌለ አረጋግጠዋል።
oromo: Awurooppaa keessatti sobaan ololamee kan dhihaate boombiin ergamee jira jechuun balaliiwwan hedduu irratti gufuun uumamee jira. Xiyyaarotni yoo xiqqaate 27 ta'an dirqamaan buufatanii fi namootni keessaa baafamanii jiru. Ogeeyyotni qorannoo erga gaggeessanii booda, himatawwan kunneen dhugaa akka hin taane fi balaan tokkollee akka hin jirre mirkaneessanii jiru.

title: Supermajority of Jewish Americans think Israel and Aipac drive antisemitism
english: A recent poll commissioned by J Street reveals that a large majority of Jewish Americans believe the actions of Israel and Aipac are contributing to rising antisemitism in the United States. Many voters feel that Aipac's political spending against critics of Israel, along with the strategic labeling of anti-Israel rhetoric as hate speech, undermines genuine efforts to address prejudice. This finding highlights a significant disagreement between ordinary Jewish voters and major pro-Israel organizations regarding the root causes of antisemitism.
amharic: በጄ ስትሪት በተካሄደ አዲስ የዳሰሳ ጥናት መሰረት፣ አብዛኛዎቹ አይሁዳዊ አሜሪካውያን የእስራኤል መንግስት እና የአይፓክ (Aipac) እንቅስቃሴዎች በአሜሪካ የፀረ-ሴማዊነት ስሜትን እየጨመሩ እንደሆነ ያምናሉ። ብዙዎቹ መራጮች አይፓክ እስራኤልን የሚተቹ እጩዎችን ለመዋጋት የሚያወጣው ገንዘብ እና የእስራኤልን ፖሊሲ የሚቃወሙ ወገኖችን እንደ ፀረ-ሴማዊነት መፈረጅ፣ ለራሱ ፖለቲካዊ ጥቅማ ጥቅም ሲባል የሚደረግ እንደሆነ ይገልጻሉ። ይህ ጥናት በአሜሪካ የሚኖሩ አይሁዳውያን አስተያየት እና ዋና ዋናዎቹ የእስራኤል ደጋፊ ድርጅቶች ከሚይዙት አቋም መካከል ያለውን ከፍተኛ ልዩነት ያሳያል።
oromo: Qorannoon 'J Street' gaggeesse akka agarsiisutti, Yihuudotni Ameerikaa hedduun gochi mootummaa Israa'elii fi dhaabbanni 'Aipac' biyya Ameerikaa keessatti jibba Yihuudotaa (antisemitism) akka dabalaa jiru amanu. Hirmaattootni qorannichaa, Aipac namoota Israa'elin qeeqan irratti maallaqa baasanii duuluun isaanii fi qeeqicha akka jibba Yihuudotaatti fudhachuun isaanii, rakkoo dhugaa kanaaf akka hin gargaarre ibsaniiru. Kunis yaada Yihuudota idilee fi dhaabbilee Israa'el deeggaran jidduutti garaa garummaan bal’aan jiraachuu isaa kan agarsiisuudha.

title: Trump says Iran 'not doing anything' on nuclear programme without US approval
english: President Donald Trump recently asserted that Iran is unable to advance its nuclear program without consent from the United States. He made this statement while discussing ongoing international mediation efforts concerning Iran's nuclear activities. Trump’s remarks highlight his stance that American approval is a necessary condition for any developments in the Iranian nuclear sector.
amharic: ፕሬዝዳንት ዶናልድ ትራምፕ ኢራን ያለ አሜሪካ ፈቃድ በኑክሌር መርሃ ግብሯ ላይ ምንም አይነት እርምጃ መውሰድ እንደማትችል በቅርቡ ተናግረዋል። ይህን የተናገሩት ስለ ኢራን የኑክሌር የወደፊት እጣ ፈንታ እየቀረቡ ባሉ መፍትሄዎች ላይ አስተያየት ሲሰጡ ነው። የትራምፕ ንግግር የአሜሪካ ይሁንታ ለኢራን የኑክሌር ጉዳዮች ወሳኝ መሆኑን የሚያሳይ ነው።
oromo: Pireezidaant Donald Tiraamp, Iraan fedhii Ameerikaa malee sagantaa niwukilara ishee irratti jijjiirama kamiyyuu gochuu akka hin dandeenye ibsaniiru. Yaada kana kan kennan waa'ee rakkoo niwukilara Iraan furuuf gargaartotaan dhiyaata jiru irratti mari'achaa turan. Ibsi Tiraamp kun, raawwii sagantaa niwukilara Iraan irratti hayyamni Ameerikaa murteessaa ta'uu isaa agarsiisa.

title: Turkey's parliament ratifies Mecca defence pact, clearing way for military support to Saudi Arabia
english: The Turkish parliament has officially approved the Mecca Joint Defence Agreement, a security pact involving Turkey, Saudi Arabia, and Pakistan. This agreement establishes a mutual defense policy where an attack on one member is considered an attack on all three. This move allows Turkey to provide military assistance and potentially deploy personnel to Saudi Arabia to help protect the kingdom from Houthi attacks.
amharic: የቱርክ ፓርላማ በቱርክ፣ በሳውዲ አረቢያ እና በፓኪስታን መካከል የተደረገውን የመካ የጋራ መከላከያ ስምምነት በይፋ አጽድቋል። ይህ ስምምነት በአንዱ አባል ላይ የሚሰነዘር ጥቃት በሦስቱም አገራት ላይ እንደተፈጸመ የሚቆጠርበትን የጋራ መከላከያ መርህ ይዘረጋል። ውሳኔው ቱርክ በሳውዲ አረቢያ ላይ ከየመን በሚሰነዘሩ የሁቲ አማጽያን ጥቃቶች ራሷን እንድትከላከል ወታደራዊ ድጋፍ እንድታደርግ እና ወታደሮችን እንድትልክ መንገድ ይከፍታል።
oromo: Mana maree biyyattii kan Turkii, waliigaltee ittisa waloo kan Makkaa, kan biyyoota Turkii, Saudii Arabiyaa fi Paakistaan gidduutti godhame raggaasiseera. Waliigalteen kun, biyyoota kana keessaa tokko irratti yoo haleellaan raawwatame, akka haleellaa sadanuu irratti raawwatametti kan ilaalamu ta'uu isaa tuma. Tarkaanfin kun, Turkii haleellaa garee Huutii kanneen Yemen irraa ka'anii Saudii Arabiyaa irratti raawwatamaniin walqabatee, gargaarsa waraanaa akka kennituufi waraana ishee gara biyyattii akka ergitu hayyama.

title: Supermajority of Jewish Americans think Israel and Aipac drive antisemitism
english: A recent poll commissioned by J Street reveals that a large majority of Jewish Americans believe the actions of Israel and the lobbying group Aipac are fueling antisemitism within the United States. Many respondents feel that labeling criticism of Israel as antisemitic is a tactic used to protect controversial government policies. Furthermore, the survey highlights a divide between political leaders favored by Jewish voters and those supported by traditional pro-Israel organizations.
amharic: በጄ ስትሪት አማካኝነት የተካሄደ አዲስ ጥናት እንደሚያሳየው፣ አብዛኛዎቹ አሜሪካውያን አይሁዶች የእስራኤል መንግስት እና የአይፓክ (Aipac) እንቅስቃሴዎች በአሜሪካ የፀረ-አይሁድ ጥላቻ እንዲጨምር እያደረጉ እንደሆነ ያምናሉ። ብዙዎቹ ታዳሚዎች እስራኤልን መተቸትን እንደ ፀረ-አይሁድነት መፈረጅ፣ የሀገሪቱን አወዛጋቢ ፖሊሲዎች ለመከላከል የሚውል ስልት እንደሆነ ይገልጻሉ። ጥናቱ በተጨማሪም፣ አብዛኛዎቹ አይሁዳውያን መራጮች እስራኤልን ከሚደግፉ ድርጅቶች ይልቅ፣ የእስራኤልን ፖሊሲ የሚቃወሙ ፖለቲከኞችን እንደሚደግፉ አሳይቷል።
oromo: Qorannoon haaraan 'J Street'an gaggeeffame akka agarsiisutti, baay'een lammiilee Ameerikaa kanneen Ayihuudota ta'an, gochi Israa'el fi gareen 'Aipac' jedhamu Ameerikaa keessatti jibba Ayihuudotaa (antisemitism) akka dabalaa jiru amanu. Hordoftoonni hedduun, Israa'eliin ceeffachuu akka jibba Ayihuudotaatti fudhachuun, siyaasa mootummaa Israa'el kan fudhatama hin qabne ittisuuf mala fayyadamamu ta'uu ibsu. Qorannoon kunis, Ayihuudonni hedduun qaamolee Israa'el deggeran irra, siyaasa Israa'el kan ceeffatan hogganoota filachuu isaanii agarsiisa.

title: Israel's UN ambassador rejects Vance's claim that Iran war was behind midterm losses
english: Israel's UN ambassador, Danny Danon, has pushed back against claims by JD Vance that the conflict with Iran caused Republican losses in recent elections. Danon argued that it is unfair to blame Israel for domestic economic issues like rising oil prices. He emphasized that the decision to strike Iran was a US initiative that Israel merely supported as a correct move.
amharic: የእስራኤል የተባበሩት መንግስታት አምባሳደር ዳኒ ዳኖን፣ ከኢራን ጋር የተደረገው ጦርነት በሪፐብሊካኖች ላይ ለደረሰው የምርጫ ሽንፈት ምክንያት ነው የሚለውን የጄ ዲ ቫንስን አስተያየት ውድቅ አድርገዋል። አምባሳደሩ እንደ ዘይት ዋጋ መጨመር ያሉ የውስጥ ኢኮኖሚ ችግሮችን በእስራኤል ላይ ማሳበብ ተገቢ እንዳልሆነ ገልጸዋል። በኢራን ላይ ጥቃት የመሰንዘር ውሳኔ የአሜሪካ እንጂ የእስራኤል አለመሆኑን እና እስራኤል ያንን ውሳኔ የደገፈችው ትክክል ስለሆነ ነው ብለዋል።
oromo: Ambaasaaddarri Israa'eel kan Tokkummaa Mootummootaa Daanii Daanoon, waraanni Iran kan sababa ta'eef reppaabilikaanonni filannoo irratti mo'atamaniiru jechuun J.D Vaansi yaada kennan mormaniiru. Ambaasaaddarichi rakkoolee diinagdee biyya keessaa kan akka gatiin boba'aa dabaluu Israa'eel irratti komachuun sirrii miti jedhaniiru. Iran irratti haleellaa raawwachuun murtee Ameerikaa malee murtee Israa'eel akka hin taaneefi, Israa'eel murtee kana kan deggerte sirrii waan ta'eef qofa ta'uu ibsaniiru.

title: France holds new strikes and protests as unions demand immediate answers
english: Across France, five major unions led a national day of strikes and protests to demand higher wages and better support for public services amid rising living costs. Over 250,000 demonstrators took to the streets in various cities, causing significant disruptions to transport, schools, and major tourist sites like the Eiffel Tower. While most events were peaceful, authorities reported violent clashes with police in cities like Lyon and Rennes, prompting a large-scale security deployment.
amharic: በፈረንሳይ የሚገኙ አምስት ዋና ዋና የሠራተኛ ማህበራት የኑሮ ውድነትን ለመቋቋም የሚያስችል የደመወዝ ጭማሪ እና ለሕዝብ አገልግሎቶች የተሻለ ድጋፍ በመጠየቅ አገራዊ የአድማ እና የተቃውሞ ሰልፍ አካሂደዋል። ከ250,000 በላይ ሰዎች በተለያዩ ከተሞች በመውጣታቸው በትምህርት ቤቶች፣ በትራንስፖርት እና በቱሪስት መዳረሻዎች ላይ ከፍተኛ መስተጓጎል ተፈጥሯል። አብዛኛዎቹ ሰልፎች በሰላማዊ መንገድ ቢካሄዱም፣ በሊዮን እና በሬን ከተሞች ከፖሊስ ጋር ግጭቶች በመፈጠራቸው መንግሥት የፀጥታ ኃይሎችን በስፋት አሰማርቷል።
oromo: Faransaay keessatti gamtoota hojjettootaa gurguddaa shan ta'an, gatii jireenyaa dabaluu isaatiin wal-qabatee mindaan akka dabaluu fi tajaajilli uummataa akka fooyya'u gaafachuun guyyaa sagantaa tarkaanfii fi hiriira guutuu biyyattii gaggeessaniiru. Namoonni kuma 250 ol ta'an magaalonni garaa garaa keessatti hiriira ba'uun, geejjiba, manneen barnootaa fi bakkeewwan seena-qabeeyyii ta'an irratti miidhaan akka ga'u taasisaniiru. Hiriirichi yeroo baay'ee nagaan kan gaggeeffame ta'us, magaalonni Lyon fi Rennes keessatti walitti bu'iinsi poolisii waliin waan uumameef, mootummaan humna nageenyaa gahaa ta'e bobbaaseera.

title: Paraguay President Santiago Peña resigns after bank collapse
english: Paraguay's President Santiago Peña has resigned following a massive political crisis triggered by the collapse of Ueno Bank, which held funds for millions of citizens. Lawmakers accused the president of conflicts of interest due to his previous ties to the bank, leading to impeachment proceedings and widespread public protests. Peña stated he is stepping down to ensure national stability, while the government works to restore access to frozen accounts.
amharic: የፓራጓይ ፕሬዝዳንት ሳንቲያጎ ፔኛ በሚሊዮኖች የሚቆጠሩ ዜጎች ገንዘብ የያዘው የዩኤኖ ባንክ መክሰርን ተከትሎ በተፈጠረ የፖለቲካ ቀውስ ስልጣናቸውን ለቀዋል። የፓርላማ አባላት ከባንኩ ጋር የነበራቸው የቀድሞ ግንኙነት የጥቅም ግጭት ፈጥሯል በሚል የክስ ሂደት መጀመራቸው እና ህዝባዊ ተቃውሞዎች መቀስቀሳቸው ለስልጣን መልቀቃቸው ምክንያት ሆኗል። ፕሬዝዳንቱ የሀገሪቱን ሰላም እና መረጋጋት ለመጠበቅ ሲሉ ስልጣናቸውን መልቀቃቸውን ገልጸው፣ መንግስትም የታገደውን የባንክ አገልግሎት ለማስተካከል እየሰራ ይገኛል።
oromo: Pireezidaantiin Paraaguwaay Saantiyaagoo Peenyaa baankiin Ueno jedhamu cufamuun isaa rakkoo siyaasaa guddaa waan uumeef aangoo gad-hiisaniiru. Baankichi qabeenya lammiilee miliyoonaan lakkaawwamu waan qabateef, Pireezidaantichi kanaan dura baankicha wajjin walitti dhufeenya qabaachuu isaaniitiin walqabatee mormiin guddaan fi adeemsi isaan aangoo irraa kaasuuf jalqabamee ture. Pireezidaantichi nageenya biyyaa fi tasgabbii eeguuf jecha akka aangoo gad-hiisan ibsanii, mootummaan immoo maallaqa lammiilee qabame deebisuuf hojjechaa jira.

title: Was an Italian chef really fired over refusal to put pineapple on pizza?
english: Italian chef Davide Tamburella was dismissed from his job at a Brisbane restaurant following multiple complaints about his behavior. One notable incident involved his refusal to serve pineapple on pizza, which he argued was insulting to his culinary heritage. Although this specific disagreement drew public attention, his firing was the result of a series of workplace conduct issues.
amharic: ጣሊያናዊው ሼፍ ዳቪዴ ታምቡሬላ በብሪስቤን በሚገኝ ምግብ ቤት ውስጥ በስነ-ምግባር ጉድለት የተነሳ ከስራ ተባረረ። ከቀረቡበት ቅሬታዎች መካከል አንዱ አናናስን በፒዛ ላይ ማድረግ ባህሉን የሚቃረን ነው በማለት ለመስራት ፈቃደኛ አለመሆኑ ነው። ምንም እንኳን ይህ ጉዳይ የብዙዎችን ትኩረት ቢስብም፣ የስራ መልቀቂያው ግን ከተከታታይ የስነ-ምግባር ችግሮች ጋር የተያያዘ ነበር።
oromo: Saffisiin lammii Xaaliyaanii Davide Tamburella jedhamu, qondaaltota mana nyaataa Birisbeen jiru tokkoo irraa amala isaa wajjin walqabatee komii hedduu erga irratti dhiyaatee booda hojii irraa ari'ame. Komiiwwan isaa keessaa inni tokko piizaa irratti anaanaas godhuun aadaa isaa akka tuqu dubbachuun diduu isaa ti. Haalli kun xiyyeeffannaa ummataa kan hawwate ta'us, ari'atamni isaa rakkoolee amala hojii irratti mul'atan hedduu walitti qabachuun kan dhufe dha.

title: The Pitt and ER are similar enough for lawsuit to proceed, judge rules
english: A U.S. court has ruled that a lawsuit against the producers of the medical drama The Pitt can proceed to trial because of its striking similarities to the classic series ER. Sherri Crichton, the widow of ER creator Michael Crichton, claims that the new show is an unauthorized reboot that violates her late husband's contractual rights. While the judges dismissed claims against individual producers, they agreed that the case against the studio should be decided by a jury.
amharic: የአሜሪካ ፍርድ ቤት በህክምና ድራማ 'ዘ ፒት' አምራቾች ላይ የቀረበው ክስ ከታዋቂው 'ኢ አር' ተከታታይ የቴሌቪዥን ድራማ ጋር ከፍተኛ ተመሳሳይነት ስላለው ወደ ችሎት እንዲቀጥል ወስኗል። የ'ኢ አር' ፈጣሪ ሚካኤል ክሪችተን ባለቤት፣ አዲሱ ስራ ባሏ ካስቀመጠው የኮንትራት መብት ውጭ የተሰራ ህገ-ወጥ የድራማው ዳግም ስራ (ሪቡት) ነው በማለት ይከራከራሉ። ዳኞቹ በግለሰብ አምራቾች ላይ የቀረበውን ክስ ውድቅ ቢያደርጉም፣ ስቱዲዮው ላይ የቀረበው ክስ በጁሪ እንዲታይ ፈቅደዋል።
oromo: Mana murtii Ameerikaa tokko qophii 'The Pitt' jedhamu kanneen qopheessan irratti himanni dhiyaate, qophii 'ER' jedhamu wajjin wal fakkeenya guddaa waan qabuuf gara mana murtii sadarkaa lammaffaatti darbeera. Haati manaa uumaa qophii 'ER' kan ta'an Maykil Krichiten, qophiin kun hayyama malee fi mallattoo isaanii malee kan hojjetamee fi mirga abbaa qabeenyummaa cabsuudha jedhaniiru. Abbootiin murtii qopheessitoota dhuunfaa irratti himanni dhiyaate gadi dhiisanis, himanni dhaabbata filmii irratti dhiyaate garuu akka juriidhaan ilaalamu murteessaniiru.

title: Jordanian officer killed in stabbing attack in Amman
english: A Jordanian security officer was killed and another was injured during a stabbing attack near the Sri Lankan embassy in Amman. Authorities have officially classified the incident as an act of terrorism. An investigation is currently underway to address the attack.
amharic: በአማን በሚገኘው የሲሪላንካ ኤምባሲ አቅራቢያ በተፈጸመ የቢላዋ ጥቃት አንድ የዮርዳኖስ የጸጥታ አባል ሲገደል ሌላኛው ደግሞ ቆስሏል። ባለስልጣናት ይህንን ድርጊት የሽብር ጥቃት መሆኑን አረጋግጠዋል። በጥቃቱ ላይ ምርመራ እየተካሄደ ይገኛል።
oromo: Amman keessatti naannoo embasii Siirilankaa biratti namni dhaabbata nageenyaa Yordan tokko waraantee ajjeefameera, kaanis madaa'eera. Aangeyyoonni biyyattii miidhaa kana akka gocha shororkeessummaatti ramadaniiru. Amma qaamoleen nageenyaa balaa kana ilaalchisee qorannoo eegalaniiru.

title: Paraguay President Pena resigns in wake of bank collapse
english: Paraguayan President Santiago Pena has resigned following a massive financial crisis triggered by the collapse of the digital bank ueno. The bank's failure locked millions of customers out of their accounts and sparked allegations of government negligence and corruption regarding the management of public funds. Vice President Pedro Alliana is expected to assume power as lawmakers continue to push for legal accountability despite the president's departure.
amharic: የፓራጓይ ፕሬዝዳንት ሳንቲያጎ ፔና የዲጂታል ባንክ ዩኤኖ (ueno) መክሰርን ተከትሎ በተፈጠረ ከፍተኛ የኢኮኖሚ ቀውስ ምክንያት ከስልጣናቸው ለቀቁ። የባንኩ መክሰር በሚሊዮን የሚቆጠሩ ደንበኞች ገንዘባቸውን እንዳያገኙ ማድረጉ ብቻ ሳይሆን፣ መንግስት የህዝብ ገንዘብን በአግባቡ ባለማስተዳደርና በሙስና እንዲጠረጠር አድርጓል። ፕሬዝዳንቱ ስልጣናቸውን ቢለቁም፣ የሀገሪቱ የህግ አውጪ አካላት ተጠያቂነትን ለማረጋገጥ ጥረታቸውን የቀጠሉ ሲሆን ምክትል ፕሬዝዳንት ፔድሮ አሊያና ስልጣኑን እንደሚረከቡ ይጠበቃል።
oromo: Pireezidaantiin Paraaguwaay Saantiyaagoo Peenaa, baankiin dijitaalaa 'ueno' diigamuu isaa hordofee rakkoo diinagdee cimaa uumameen walqabatee aangoo gadhiisaniiru. Kuufamni baankichaa maamiltoonni miiliyoonotaan lakkaa'aman qarshii isaanii argachuu akka hin dandeenye kan godhe yoo ta'u, mootummaan qabeenya uummataa to'achuu irratti tuffii fi malaammaltummaan akka himatamu godheera. Pireezidaantichi aangoo gadhiisus, miseensonni mana maree biyyattii qaama seeraa gaafachuuf yaalii itti fufanii jiran; itti aantuun pireezidaantichaa Peedroo Aliyaanaan aangoo akka fudhatanis eegama.

title: Bishara: US election deals a blow to warmongers
english: Al Jazeera political analyst Marwan Bishara suggests that the recent US election results represent a significant defeat for nationalist populists and advocates of global conflict. He argues that voters are signaling a clear desire to move away from continuous military involvement in the Middle East. Furthermore, the outcome suggests a shifting public sentiment regarding the traditional policy of offering unconditional support to Israel.
amharic: የአልጀዚራ የፖለቲካ ተንታኝ ማርዋን ቢሻራ የቅርብ ጊዜ የአሜሪካ ምርጫ ውጤት ለጦርነት ደጋፊዎች እና ለሕዝባዊ ፖፑሊስቶች ትልቅ ሽንፈት እንደሆነ ይገልጻሉ። አሜሪካውያን በመካከለኛው ምስራቅ ተጨማሪ ወታደራዊ ጣልቃ ገብነቶችን እንደማይፈልጉ ምርጫው እንደሚያሳይ ተንታኙ አስረድተዋል። ከዚህም በላይ ውጤቱ ለእስራኤል የሚደረገውን ያለምንም ቅድመ ሁኔታ ድጋፍ በተመለከተ የአሜሪካ ሕዝብ አቋም እየተቀየረ መምጣቱን ያሳያል።
oromo: Qaaccessaan siyaasaa Al-Jazeera Marwaan Bishaaraa, bu'aan filannoo Ameerikaa dhihoo kanaa mormitoota waraanaa fi namoota biyya jaalalaan faarfatan biratti injifannoo guddaa akka ta'e dubbatu. Uummanni Ameerikaa hirmaannaa waraanaa gara fuulduraa kan biyyoota giddu-galeessa bahaa keessatti gaggeeffamu akka hin barbaanne filannoon kun agarsiiseera. Dabalataanis, bu'aan kun deeggarsa Israa'eliif taasifamu kan haala malee kennamu ilaalchisee yaanni uummataa jijjiiramaa jiraachuu isaa mul'isa.

title: Gaza holds final of tournament honouring more than 1,000 slain athletes
english: Gaza has successfully concluded the 'Thousand Martyrs' Cup, a football tournament held to pay tribute to the over 1,000 Palestinian athletes who have lost their lives since October 2023. This event marks the restoration of organized sports in the region after a three-year hiatus caused by the ongoing war. Despite the significant devastation surrounding them, the games provided a brief and necessary opportunity for spectators and players to experience a sense of unity and happiness.
amharic: ጋዛ ከጥቅምት 2023 ጀምሮ ሕይወታቸውን ላጡ ከ1,000 በላይ ለሚሆኑ ፍልስጤማውያን አትሌቶች መታሰቢያ የሚሆን 'የሺህ ሰማዕታት ዋንጫ' የተሰኘ የእግር ኳስ ውድድር አካሂዳለች። ይህ ውድድር ለሶስት ዓመታት ያህል በጦርነት ምክንያት ተቋርጦ የነበረውን ስፖርታዊ እንቅስቃሴ ዳግም ያስጀመረ ነው። በዙሪያቸው ባለው ከፍተኛ ውድመት መካከልም ቢሆን፣ ውድድሩ ለተመልካቾች እና ለተጫዋቾች አልፎ አልፎ የሚገኝ የደስታ እና የአንድነት ጊዜ ፈጥሮላቸዋል።
oromo: Gaazaan tapha kubbaa miilaa 'Qancaraa Aarsaa Kumaa' jedhamu kan gaggeessite, atileetota Falasxiin kanneen Onkoloolessa 2023 irraa eegalee du'aan dhabaman kuma tokko ol yaadachuufi. Taphi kun waraana waggaa sadiif turuun addaan citee ture booda, ammas guddina isaa eeggatee akka deebi'u taasiseera. Gamoo fi bu'uuraalee barbadoofnii jiranillee osoo hin daangessin, taphi kun taphattootaafii daawwattootaaf yeroo gammachuu fi tokkummaan itti dhaga'amu kenneera.

title: Photos: Spain mourns Jesus de Miguel, who died after on-pitch collision
english: The Spanish football community is mourning the death of 30-year-old CD Tenerife player Jesus de Miguel, who passed away following a fatal on-pitch collision during a second-division match. High-profile figures, including Spain's national coach and the Real Madrid president, attended his funeral in Navahermosa to show their support. Authorities are currently investigating the incident as a routine matter to determine the nature of the challenge that led to the tragedy.
amharic: የስፔን እግር ኳስ ማህበረሰብ በሁለተኛው ዲቪዚዮን ጨዋታ ወቅት በደረሰ ግጭት ህይወቱ ያለፈውን የ30 አመቱ የሲዲ ቴኔሪፌ ተጫዋች ኢየሱስ ደ ሚጌልን ሞት እያዘኑ ይገኛሉ። የስፔን ብሔራዊ ቡድን አሰልጣኝ እና የሪያል ማድሪድ ፕሬዝዳንትን ጨምሮ ታዋቂ ሰዎች በናቫሄርሞሳ በተካሄደው የቀብር ስነስርዓት ላይ በመገኘት ሃዘናቸውን ገልጸዋል። ባለስልጣናት በአደጋው ወቅት የተከሰተው ግጭት ህጋዊነት ላይ ምርመራ እያደረጉ ነው።
oromo: Hawaasni kubbaa miillaa Ispeen taphataa kilabii CD Tenerife kan umuriin isaa 30 ta'e, Jesus de Miguel, tapha gita lammaffaa irratti miidhaa dirree irratti isa mudateen du'uu isaatiin gadda cimaa keessa jira. Pirezidaantiin kilabii Real Madrid fi leenjisaan garee biyyoolessa Ispeen dabalatee namoonni gurguddoon sirna awwaalcha isaa magaala Navahermosa keessatti gaggeeffame irratti argamuun gadda isaanii ibsaniiru. Qaamoleen nageenyaa haala gochi kun itti raawwatame irratti qorannoo geggeessaa jiru.

title: Vance walks Trump tightrope with scathing election critique blaming Iran war
english: Vice President JD Vance has publicly blamed the ongoing war in Iran for the Republican Party's significant losses in the recent midterm elections, where Democrats gained control of both the House and the Senate. By openly criticizing the conflict, Vance appears to be distancing himself from President Trump's policies as he considers his own potential presidential run for 2028. This statement marks a rare public break from the administration, as Vance challenges the political necessity of the military engagement.
amharic: ምክትል ፕሬዝዳንት ጄዲ ቫንስ በቅርቡ በተካሄደው የመካከለኛው ዘመን ምርጫ ለሪፐብሊካን ፓርቲ ሽንፈት ዋነኛው ምክንያት በአይራን እየተካሄደ ያለው ጦርነት ነው ሲሉ በይፋ ተናገሩ። ዲሞክራቶች ሁለቱንም የኮንግረስ ምክር ቤቶች መቆጣጠራቸውን ተከትሎ፣ ቫንስ ከዚህ ጦርነት ጋር ያላቸውን ልዩነት በማሳየት የ2028 የፕሬዝዳንታዊ ምርጫ እጩነታቸውን እየተዘጋጁበት ሊሆን ይችላል። ይህ አስተያየታቸው ከፕሬዝዳንት ትራምፕ የፖሊሲ አቋም ጋር ያላቸውን አለመግባባት በይፋ ያሳያል።
oromo: Itti aanaa pirezidantii JD Vance tarkaanfii mootummaan isaanii Iran waliin gochaa jiruun walqabatee filannoo giddu galeessaa irratti paartin isaanii injifatamuun isaa dogoggora siyaasaa guddaa akka ta'e dubbatan. Paartiin Demokiraatotaa mana maree bakka buutotaa fi mana maree ol'aanaa to'achuu isaanii hordofee, Vance tarkaanfii waraanaa kana balaaleffachuun gara fuulduraatti pirezidantii ta'uuf yaada akka qaban kan agarsiisuudha. Yaanni kun pirezidant Donald Trump waliin walitti dhufeenya siyaasaa isaanii irratti addaan ba'uu kan agarsiisuudha.

title: What Democrats can and can't do with their new power after taking Congress
english: Democrats have secured control over both the House and the Senate following a significant victory in the recent midterm elections. Despite this legislative majority, they will face challenges in implementing their agenda because President Donald Trump maintains the power to veto their proposals. Party leaders acknowledge the need to address economic concerns like high costs and low wages to prove their effectiveness to the public.
amharic: ዲሞክራቶች በቅርቡ በተካሄደው የመካከለኛው ዘመን ምርጫ ሁለቱንም የኮንግረስ ምክር ቤቶች መቆጣጠር ችለዋል። ምንም እንኳን በሕግ አውጪው አካል ውስጥ አብላጫ ድምፅ ቢኖራቸውም፣ ፕሬዝዳንት ዶናልድ ትራምፕ ውሳኔዎቻቸውን የመሻር ስልጣን ስላላቸው ያቀዱትን ለማሳካት አስቸጋሪ ሊሆንባቸው ይችላል። የፓርቲው መሪዎች ህዝቡን ለማሳመን የኑሮ ውድነትን እና የደመወዝ ክፍያን የመሳሰሉ ኢኮኖሚያዊ ችግሮችን መፍታት እንደሚገባቸው አምነዋል።
oromo: Diimokiraatonni filannoo gidduu waggaa kanaan booda mana maree bakka bu'oota ummataa fi mana maree olaanaa lamaanuu to'achuuf danda'aniiru. Ta'us, pirezedaanti Doonaald Tiraamp karoora isaanii mormuuf ykn dhoorkuuf aangoo waan qabaniif, hojiirra oolchuun isaanii rakkisaa ta'uu danda'a. Hogganoonni paartichaa, abdii ummataa guutuuf jecha rakkoo gatii gabaa fi mindaa xiqqaa furuun akka irraa eegamu beeksisaniiru.

title: Joshua Wong, face of Hong Kong's pro-democracy protests, jailed for 10 years
english: Joshua Wong, a prominent figure in Hong Kong's pro-democracy movement, has been sentenced to 10 years in prison for conspiring with foreign powers under the city's national security law. Although he was expected to be released early next year, this new sentence significantly extends his time behind bars. Authorities accused Wong of lobbying for international sanctions against Beijing, an action they claim threatens regional stability.

oromo: Hoggantoonni sochii dimokiraasii Hong Kong keessatti beekamtii qaban Joshua Wong, seera nageenya biyyaa cabsuun humnoota alaa wajjin wal ta'uun himatamee waggaa 10 hidhaa itti murameera. Waggaa dhufu gadi lakkifama jedhamee kan eegamu ta'us, murtiin kun yeroo hidhaa isaa baay'ee dheeressera. Mootummaan akka himatetti, Wong biyya Chaayinaa irratti tarkaanfii diinagdee akka fudhatamu gochuun tasgabbii naannichaa booressera jedhamee himatame.

title: Italian chef fired after refusing to put pineapple on pizza
english: An Italian chef working in Australia was fired from his job after repeatedly refusing to add pineapple to pizzas, claiming the ingredient was culturally offensive. While the chef challenged his dismissal in court, his claim was rejected because it was filed past the legal deadline. Additionally, the restaurant management cited other workplace concerns, including the chef's poor communication and aggressive behavior, as reasons for his termination.

oromo: Aadaa keenyatti kan hin taane jechuun, pizza irratti ananas gochuuf waan dideef, abbichi nyaataa Itoaliyaa tokko Awustiraaliyaa keessatti hojii irraa ari'ame. Nyaata gaggeessituu kana irratti himata dhiyeessus, yeroon seeraa darbuu isaatiin himatichi fudhatama dhabeera. Kana malees, qajeelchi mana nyaata sanaa, gochaan kun kan raawwatame amala isaa fi haasawa isaa waliin wal qabatee rakkoon jiraachuun ibsameera.

title: Russia says it hit Ukrainian postal hub and ship as Ukraine strikes Ryazan
english: Russia and Ukraine exchanged significant overnight drone strikes, targeting vital energy and logistics infrastructure on both sides. Russian forces claimed to have hit a Ukrainian postal hub, a power station, and a cargo ship, while Ukrainian drone attacks caused industrial fires in the Russian city of Ryazan. Both nations reported injuries among their populations as a result of these intensifying aerial assaults.

oromo: Raashiyaan fi Yuukireen galgala keessa walitti aansanii haleellaa doroonii irratti raawwatan kanaan bu'uuraalee misoomaa humna ibsaa fi loojistikii miidhamaniiru. Raashiyaan buufata poostaa, buufata humna ibsaa fi doonii fe'umsaa Yuukireen haleeluushee yoo ibsitu, gama biraan ammoo dorooniiwwan Yuukireen magaalaa Raashiyaa Raazaani keessatti iddoowwan industirii irratti ibidda kaasuunsaanii gabaafameera. Haleellaa qilleensa irraa raawwatame kanaan biyyoota lamaan keessattuu miidhaan qaamaa namoota irra ga'eera.

title: Wembanyama pours in career-high 52 points as Spurs edge Mavericks 112-111
english: Victor Wembanyama led the San Antonio Spurs to a narrow 112-111 victory over the Dallas Mavericks by scoring a career-high 52 points and grabbing 24 rebounds. Despite a late rally by Dallas, Wembanyama secured the win by hitting a decisive free throw in the final seconds and recording eight blocks throughout the game. This impressive performance extended the Spurs' winning streak to six games while handing the Mavericks their second consecutive defeat.
amharic: ቪክቶር ዌምባንያማ 52 ነጥቦችን በማስመዝገብ እና 24 ጊዜ ኳስን በመቀማት የሳን አንቶኒዮ ስፐርስ ዳላስ ማቬሪክስን 112 ለ 111 እንዲያሸንፉ አስችሏቸዋል። ዳላስ በጨዋታው መጨረሻ ላይ መሪነትን ቢይዝም፣ ዌምባንያማ በመጨረሻዎቹ ሰከንዶች ባስቆጠራት ነጻ ውርወራ ቡድኑን አሸናፊ አድርጓል። ይህ ድል ስፐርስ টানা ስድስተኛ ድላቸውን እንዲቀዳጁ እና ማቬሪክስ ሁለተኛ ተከታታይ ሽንፈታቸውን እንዲቀምሱ አድርጓል።
oromo: Fiiktori Weembaaniyaamaa qabxii 52 galchuufi kubbaa 24 mo'achuun isaa, gareen Saan Antooniyoo Spersi (San Antonio Spurs) garee Daalaas Maaveeriksii (Dallas Mavericks) 112-111 akka injifatu taasiseera. Gareen Daalaas yeroo xumuraa irratti qabxii dhiheessuuf carraaqqii godheyyuu, Weembaaniyaamaan daqiiqaa dhumaa irratti qabxii bilisaa galchuun injifannoo garee isaatiif mirkaneesseera. Injifannoon kun Spersi mo'annoo isaanii itti fufsiisee injifannoo ja'affaa galmeessisuu danda'eera, akkasumas Maaveeriksii injifatamuufi injifatamuu isaanii lammaffaa ta'eera.

title: Hong Kong democracy activist Joshua Wong sentenced to 10 years in jail
english: Hong Kong democracy activist Joshua Wong has been sentenced to an additional 10 years in prison after pleading guilty to colluding with foreign entities under the city's national security law. The court determined that his efforts to encourage international sanctions against the government posed a threat to national security. Although he was originally due for release in early 2027, this new ruling extends his incarceration significantly, drawing strong condemnation from international observers and the United States.
amharic: የሆንግ ኮንግ የዴሞክራሲ ተሟጋች ጆሹዋ ዎንግ በከተማዋ የብሔራዊ ደኅንነት ህግ መሰረት ከውጭ አካላት ጋር በመተባበር ጥፋተኛ ሆነው በመገኘታቸው ተጨማሪ የ10 ዓመት እስራት ተፈርዶባቸዋል። ፍርድ ቤቱ ዎንግ የውጭ ሀገራት በቻይና አስተዳደር ላይ ማዕቀብ እንዲጥሉ በመጠየቅ ብሔራዊ ደኅንነትን አደጋ ላይ ጥለዋል ሲል ወስኗል። በ2027 መጀመሪያ ላይ ይለቀቃሉ ተብሎ ሲጠበቅ የነበረው ይህ ውሳኔ የእስር ጊዜያቸውን በእጅጉ ያራዘመ ሲሆን፣ ጉዳዩ በአሜሪካ እና በዓለም አቀፍ ተቋማት ዘንድ ከፍተኛ ተቃውሞ አስነስቷል።
oromo: Qabsaa'aan mirga dimokraasii Hong Kong Joshua Wong seera nageenya biyyoolessaa cabsee biyyoota alaa waliin hidhata uumuu isaatiin yakki itti muramee waggaa 10 dabalataa itti murameera. Manni murtichaa qabsaa'ichi mootummaa irratti tarkaanfiin diinagdee akka fudhatamu biyyoota alaa gaafachuun isaa nageenya biyyattiif soda akka ta'e ibseera. Inni bara 2027 jalqaba irratti hiikamuuf kan eeggamaa ture ta'us, murtiin kun hidhaan isaa akka dheeratu taasiseera; kunis mormii guddaa biyyoota dhihaa fi qaamolee idil-addunyaa biratti kaaseera.

title: South Korea plans to expand anti-piracy operations closer to Hormuz Strait
english: South Korea is planning to broaden the scope of its Cheonghae anti-piracy naval unit to include waters near Oman, located closer to the Strait of Hormuz. This decision comes in response to American pressure to assist in the current conflict involving Iran, though Seoul maintains the mission will remain focused on protecting shipping and will not involve combat. The expansion will include additional personnel and maritime patrol aircraft, while strictly avoiding Iranian territory.
amharic: ደቡብ ኮሪያ የቼኦንግሃኤ የባህር ኃይል ቡድን የፀረ-ባህር ላይ ወንበዴዎች ስምሪት አካባቢን ወደ ኦማን የባህር ጠረፍ ለማስፋት እቅድ አውጥታለች። ይህ ውሳኔ በኢራን ጦርነት ውስጥ ድጋፍ እንድትሰጥ ከአሜሪካ የቀረበባትን ግፊት ተከትሎ የመጣ ቢሆንም፣ ሴኡል ተልእኮው የንግድ መርከቦችን ለመጠበቅ ብቻ እንደሆነና በጦርነት ውስጥ እንደማይሳተፍ አስታውቃለች። ይህ ማስፋፊያ ተጨማሪ ወታደሮችን እና የክትትል አውሮፕላኖችን የሚያካትት ሲሆን፣ የኢራንን ግዛት እና የሆርሙዝ ባህር ወሽመጥን ከመጠበቅ ግን ሙሉ በሙሉ ይቆጠባል።
oromo: Koreen Kibbaa garee waraana galaanaa Cheonghae kan seeraan alaa eeguuf bobba'e, hojiisaa gara qarqara galaana Omaanitti babal'isuuf karoorfateera. Murtoon kun dhiibbaa Ameerikaan waraana Iraan irratti gargaarsa akka godhuuf godhamte hordofee kan dhufe ta'us, Se'ul ergamichi daldala galaanaa eeguu qofa irratti kan xiyyeeffatuu fi waraana keessa kan hin galle ta'uu ibsiteerti. Babal'inni kun humna dabalataa fi xiyyoota sakatta'iinsa galaanaa kan of keessatti qabatu yoo ta'u, daangaa Iraan ykn harka galaana Hormuz kamiyyuu akka hin tuqne mirkanaa'eera.

title: Ten years of the Paris Agreement: Has the world kept its climate promises?
english: Ten years after the Paris Agreement was established to limit global warming to 1.5C, the world remains far from its climate goals despite progress in renewable energy. While almost 200 nations committed to individual emission-cutting targets, rising temperatures and record-high greenhouse gas levels show these efforts have been insufficient. Ongoing political shifts, including the United States' repeated withdrawals from the treaty, continue to complicate global cooperation and accountability.
